angry-victims.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-99: Under the Eye of the Mantis
angry-victims.descripcion: The souls of the ghouls' recent meals cry out from their pile of bones in the nearby tunnel, lamenting their fate.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 12 (trained) sets the spirits at ease, or Deception DC 15, Diplomacy DC 15, or Intimidation DC 15 to convince the spirits to not interfere right now. A single success disables the haunt. PCs may accrue additional successes beyond the first—each one convinces the haunt to use telekinetic interference once against ghouls in the haunt's range instead of the living creatures.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The haunt uses one action to activate its gurgling gasp and then uses telekinetic interference for all of its other actions until it can use gurgling gasp again.

bloodmoon.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades
bloodmoon.descripcion: Bloodmoon is a naginata that can act on its own provided it is attuned to at least one creature.

datos.desactivar: Two successful Religion DC 15 or Occultism DC 15 checks, Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 13)
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Bloodmoon uses its first action to fly up to 20 feet towards an opponent. It then makes two naginata strikes, each against a different foe.

deep-mud.descripcion: The mud greedily latches onto anything that lands in it, hampering movement.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 15 to navigate a safe path along the remaining bits of stone

empowered-blood-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-21: In Pursuit of Water
empowered-blood-1-2.descripcion: Glowing red Daemonic runes blaze when blood falls on them.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (untrained) to scratch out enough runes to disrupt the magic or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the runes.
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets at the beginning of each round until it is disabled

hidden-bog.fuente: Pathfinder Bounty #6: The Road from Otari
hidden-bog.descripcion: This section of grass-strewn ground hides a pool of sticky mud 10 feet across.

datos.desactivar: 2 Crafting DC 15 or 2 Thievery DC 18 to create a makeshift plank across the hidden bog; creatures can then traverse the hazard's area without stepping into the mud.
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still step into the mud after the trap is revealed, but the area containing the mud is obvious.

hunted-by-chains.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
hunted-by-chains.descripcion: Shadowy chains reach out to ensnare creatures trapped in the mindscape.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 17 to avoid the chains, or Arcana DC 17, Occultism DC 17, or Religion DC 17 to ritually disrupt the haunting. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one. When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled and the Scaling the Chain haunt triggers.
datos.rutina: (two actions) Spectral chains snake out to wrap around three different random creatures trapped in the haunt, who must each succeed at a Reflex DC 16 save or have the Restrained condition until it {Escapes}. Each round that a creature starts its turn Grabbed, it takes 2d4 nonlethal force damage. Spectral scars form on any creature knocked Unconscious by this haunt.
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets the next time the Soulshackle traps creatures in the library.

locking-door.descripcion: A door (or other portal) slams shut and locks.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 14 to push back against the door, Crafting DC 14 to wedge the door open, or Thievery DC 20 (trained) to jam the lock or open the lock afterward

minor-summoning-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-11: Flames of Rebellion
minor-summoning-rune.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors covers four squares on the map. One of these hazards is in the squares directly above each of the four yellow runes on the map, and the other is in the squares directly above each of the four blue runes on the map.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 13 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 15 (trained) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic(1st level; counteract DC 13) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

mirror-door.descripcion: The reflection of a wall shows a phantom door where none exists. This door can only be manipulated while viewed through the mirror's reflection.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 to open the door while viewing the reflection
datos.reinicio: The trap resets when the door is shut.

phantom-footsteps.descripcion: Audible footsteps approach from behind, but their source is not apparent.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 17 (trained) to ritually ward off lesser spirits or Occultism DC 18 to exorcise the spirit
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

shadow-double-runes-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro: Year of Shattered Sanctuaries
shadow-double-runes-1-2.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 10-foot radius surrounds a shadowy 3-foot-diameter rune on the floor.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 (trained) to carefully erase the rune without triggering the sensors, Dispel Magic or a spell with the Light trait (1st level; counteract DC 13) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each night at dusk.

shuffling-hall.descripcion: Four pressure plates along this mirrored hall rotate vertically when stepped on, sending a creature on the pressure plate tipping into an adjacent featureless room while simultaneously replacing the pressure plate and walls in the hall. Each pressure plate dumps creatures into a different room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 to deactivate one pressure plate
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 round.

smoldering-forest-fire.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-15: The Blooming Catastrophe
smoldering-forest-fire.descripcion: A fire engulfs a 10-foot-by-10-foot section of forest, then spreads on each of its turns.

datos.desactivar:
A successful Athletics DC 13, Nature DC 13, or Survival DC 13 check from an adjacent square is sufficient to smother one 5-foot-square of fire; each attempt is an Interact action. Dousing the flames automatically extinguishes one or more sections of fire, with no check. Water typically clears a 5-foot square if the amount is small (such as that from create water or hydraulic push). Larger amounts of water, such as a full bucket, typically douse a 10-foot-by-10-foot area (or 4 squares in some other shape). Throwing a bucket of water on flames requires an Interact action. A waterskin doesn't contain enough water to put out even 1 square of fire.

Cold can also put out fire, but only if the cold can affect an area; cold is usually less effective than water, so a Frost Vial typically puts out only 1 square of fire, and Ray of Frost is ineffective.
datos.rutina: On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies, minimum 1 square. The GM determines the squares the fire spreads into. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes 1d6 fire damage, and any creature within the flames takes 2d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 13 save for both). A creature can take damage from flames only once per round.

sticky-webbing.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
sticky-webbing.descripcion: Fine, sticky threads of spiders' silk are strung across their lair.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 15 or Thievery DC 15 to carefully remove the strands.
datos.reinicio: 1 day

xarwin-manor-phantasm.descripcion:
The malevolence manifests a disturbing illusion meant to unsettle and erode intruders' resistances to the manor's dangers. Roll 1d12 on the Xarwin Manor Phantasms table to determine what sort of illusion occurs; alternatively, pick an appropriate one from the table or create one of your own using the listed results as examples or inspiration.

Xarwin Manor Phantasms

1d12
Phantasm

1
A damp, ectoplasmic handprint appears on a window or wall, only to reach out of the surface briefly to try to choke a character. The hand vanishes a moment later, but the PC's left hand feels weirdly damp until it's wiped off.

2
A painless, bloodless incision manifests across a PC's forehead, completely encircling their skull over a few seconds; when the incision completes its circuit, the PC experiences a momentarily excruciating headache before the incision vanishes.

3
The PC catches a glimpse of a shadowy figure in a reflective surface; the figure raises an arm as if to point at them, yet the arm has no hand. When the PC turns to confront the image or blinks, the figure is gone.

4
The PC stumbles then notices that loose objects in the room shake, curtains swing, and floorboards shift. If a window is visible, the trees outside sway even though it's a windless day. As everything grows still, the PC gets the feeling that something immense just shifted somewhere down below. No other PC experiences this sensation.

5
The PC feels a sudden pain on their left wrist and is convinced that their hand has been cut off. Upon looking at the suspected wound, the pain vanishes and the hand looks fine.

6
The sky through a window appears to be fully night during the day, or the ceiling above suddenly fades away to reveal the night sky. The PC feels something looking back at them from somewhere between the stars, but as soon as they blink, look away, or draw attention to the night sky, the image reverts to normal.

7
The PC is suddenly overcome with the conviction that they've lived in this manor for decades and that the other PCs are trespassers, only for the feeling to vanish moments later.

8
The PC suddenly feels an overwhelming sense of betrayal from one of the other PCs-preferably the one with which they have the closest emotional ties. A heartbeat later, the feeling fades away.

9
The PC can hear what sounds like a small bird trapped in a wall, struggling for escape; no other PC can hear it. A few moments later, the PC feels that they're the trapped bird, and then the phantasm fades away.

10
The PC suddenly loses all senses and feels weightless for a split second. In the darkness, they get the creeping thought that something is about to give them the gift of sight, but they know that what they'll see will be awful. Then, everything returns to normal.

11
The PC is, for a few frightening moments, suddenly convinced that someone else is thinking for them and that they've been tricked into thinking they're in their own body when they're not.

12
The PC suddenly remembers an awful memory from their past or childhood, then feels a sense of relief as that memory is pulled from their minds. They can remember that something bad happened but not what it was.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 15 or Religion DC 15 (to exorcise the disquieting phantasm)

ancient-ooze-pit.descripcion: A trap door covers a pit that is 10 feet square and 10 feet deep. An acidic mass that was once a gelatinous cube lies at the bottom.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 to remove the trapdoor
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again. The remains of the burst ooze seep into the ground, and the trap functions as a normal Hidden Pit.

animal-pit.descripcion: A weight-activated trap door covers a pit that's 10 feet square and 20 feet deep.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 to remove the trap door
datos.reinicio: The trapdoors automatically reset to their closed position once a creature falls in, allowing for more creatures to fall in, though any camouflage on the trap door falls in as well, making it easier for creatures to notice the trap door.

blood-soaked-soil.descripcion: The blood of those who died in the area bubbles up from the earth, soaking the soil and turning it into a bloody morass.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 18 or Occultism DC 18 (trained) to settle the spirits or Religion DC 19 (trained) to bless the area
datos.reinicio: 1 day

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 19 to beat the flames with a stage curtain or similar cloth, Acrobatics DC 14 to splash liquids onto the fire, or 5 points of cold damage.

collapsing-ice.descripcion: The ice here is weak and collapses under the weight of a Small or larger creature.

datos.desactivar: 2 Crafting DC 19 to create a makeshift device to brace the ice.

confounding-portal.descripcion: Tiny runes carved around a doorframe or on a hall's walls surreptitiously confound creatures into circling the room or hallway they attempted to exit or pass through.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 to scratch out the runes, or Arcana DC 16 to destroy the runes
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 round.

crumbling-floor.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
crumbling-floor.descripcion: Around the edges of the pit, more rotting boards are ready to give way.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 14 to reinforce the beams
datos.reinicio: As the damage to the floor spreads, the areas adjacent to the new pit become new areas of this hazard.

disembodied-voices.descripcion: Angry spirits breathe down the necks of intruders and whisper haunting threats or messages in their ears.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 15 (trained) to ward yourself from evil or Performance DC 16 to drown out the spirits' voices
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

greased-floor.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades
greased-floor.descripcion: The floor is highly waxed and slippery.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 14 or Thievery DC 14 to remove the slippery coating or any ability that turns the area into difficult terrain.
datos.reinicio: Manual, reapply the wax.

haunting-presence.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
haunting-presence.descripcion: Ghostly sounds or glimpses of apparitions move to startle or distract those who walk the streets.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 16 to exorcise the haunt, or light the Eternal Lantern (automatically disables these haunts)

hidden-pit-bb.fuente: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star
hidden-pit-bb.descripcion: A wooden trapdoor covers a 10-foot square pit that's 20 feet deep.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 to remove the trapdoor.

ice-slick.descripcion: A sheer slick of ice causes anyone other than Ssalarn who attempts to cross it to slip and fall.

datos.desactivar: 2 Athletics DC 18 to break the ice and roughen its surface

mechanical-jaws-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-13: A Gilded Test
mechanical-jaws-1-2.descripcion: Mechanical jaws bolted to the stone beneath a camouflaged floor tile.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 (trained) on the jaw mechanism.

moldy-deck.descripcion: Gray mold covers a 10-foot by 25-foot section of the deck.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 13 to remove or neutralize the mold without disturbing it.

phoenix-rune-1-2.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot square surrounds an invisible rune on the wall or floor.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 15 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 16 (trained) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (1st rank, counteract DC 15) to counteract the rune.
datos.reinicio: Like its namesake creature, a phoenix rune is difficult to destroy. After it is triggered, a phoenix rune can immediately reset on a wall or floor within 120 feet, as long as it has not been disabled. When this happens, a PC who succeeds at a Perception DC 13 check spots the shadowy form of a tiny phoenix "flying" along the wall or floor from the rune's old location to its new location.

rigged-climbing-loops.descripcion: Loose handholds rip away from the walls to drop unsuspecting climbers into the chasm below.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 16 (trained) or Thievery DC 16 to anchor the climbing loops more securely

scaling-the-chain.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
scaling-the-chain.descripcion: The PCs appear on a gigantic wall of hooked chains dangling in a gray swirling mist. The chains radiate life-chilling energy Cries of innocence and condemnation echo through the mist in Elven. A plane of light 10 feet above eddies and swirls as it dully reflects the PCs below, but the reflections warp and alter the PCs to have sallow complexions like the undead.

datos.desactivar: A PC that has ascended to the plane of light (Athletics DC 13 check to Climb; on a critical failure, the PC falls 10 feet before being seized by a chain) can attempt a Thievery DC 18 check to disrupt the plane or a Arcana DC 18, Occultism DC 18 or Religion DC 18 check to ritually disrupt the haunting. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one. When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled and the PCs all return to area B3.
datos.rutina: (three actions) The chains rattle and sigh ominously around two different random creatures trapped in the haunt, dealing 1d6+2 void damage (basic Will DC 16 save).
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets the next time the Soulshackle traps creatures in the library.

sinkhole.fuente: Pathfinder Bounty #2: Blood of the Beautiful
sinkhole.descripcion: An assortment of leaves and loose dirt cover a sudden drop in elevation.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 12 to remove the covering foliage

snakebush-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-13: Within the Prairies
snakebush-1-2.descripcion: The branches of this peculiar bush are heavy with ripening berries.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 16 (trained) to avoid gathering unripe berries.

sodden-floor.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave
sodden-floor.descripcion: The floorboards here are rotting and soft, giving way and dropping anyone above into the hole below.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 16 (trained) to reinforce the compromised floorboards.

spicebomb.descripcion: Several spice bombs disguised as rocks litter the ground.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 to remove the bombs without activating them or Survival DC 13 (trained) to render them inert.

spike-launcher.descripcion: A jagged spike of metal shoots from a hidden launcher.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 16 to disable one of the four launchers or Acrobatics DC 12 to step over a trip line (this doesn't disarm the trap, but avoids triggering it)

talhindir-s-autumn.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
talhindir-s-autumn.descripcion: All lights in the room snap on, just as Lyari remembers the day of her death. A susurrus of accusations and a guilty verdict fill the air. Ghostly elven warriors disappear and reappear in a disorienting and implacable advance.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 18 to stand against the force of the verdict, or Arcana DC 18, Occultism DC 18, or Religion DC 18 to ritually disrupt the haunting. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled and the Hunted by Chains haunt triggers.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The haunt makes vengeful judgment Strikes against three different random creatures trapped in this haunt. A spectral pool of blood forms beneath any creature knocked Unconscious by this haunt.
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets the next time the Soulshackle traps creatures in the library.

unsafe-stairs.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
unsafe-stairs.descripcion: The rickety stairs groan and strain alarmingly if a Small or larger creature ascends them.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 16 to quickly jury-rig some supports to prevent the stairs from collapsing

unstable-column-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
unstable-column-1-2.descripcion: Plaster crumbles from this column moments before it collapses.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 16 (trained) to stabilize the column, Athletics DC 19 to push the column back into place

unstable-ice.descripcion: The ice here is fractured due to the warming weather conditions and the inexorable flow of the ocean water below.

datos.desactivar: 2 Athletics DC 19 to move the ice sheets into a more stable position

unstable-pit.descripcion: This open pit was once covered with branches- it's now visible, but its unstable edges are not obvious.

ancient-summoning-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #1: The Second Confirmation
ancient-summoning-rune.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 10-foot radius surrounds the central column of the room.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 15 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 17 (trained) to erase the rune, or Athletics DC 19 to remove enough stones from the pillar to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the rune.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

ankle-trap-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-04: Bandits of Immenwood
ankle-trap-1-2.descripcion: Many small pits have been dug in the road and covered with leaves and dirt to disguise them.

datos.desactivar: If spotted, the pits can be avoided by moving at one quarter of normal speed.

ankle-trap-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-04: Bandits of Immenwood
ankle-trap-3-4.descripcion: Many small pits have been dug in the road and covered with leaves and dirt to disguise them.

datos.desactivar: If spotted, the pits can be avoided by moving at one quarter of normal speed.

bloodthirsty-toy.descripcion: A scruffy stuffed bear animates, biting whoever disturbs it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to handle the toy without disturbing it or Occultism DC 21 (trained) to suppress the memories suffusing the toy
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

bloody-vortex-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-06: The Crashing Wave

datos.desactivar: Slay Silaqui, or Thievery DC 17 (trained) to pry the gem out of Silaqui followed by disrupting the gem's power by either breaking it (AC 15, Hardness 5, HP 25, BT 13) or using Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 15)
datos.rutina:
All creatures within 40 feet of the vortex except Silaqui are drawn toward it. They must attempt either a Fortitude DC 14 save or an Athletics DC 14 check to Swim with a DC of 14, with the following results.

—

Success The creature is not moved.

Failure The creature is moved 10 feet closer to the center of the vortex. If this causes the creature to reach the center square of the vortex, they are exposed to Consuming Maelstrom.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is moved 20 feet closer to the center of the vortex.

boggard-pit-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-20: The Lost Legend
boggard-pit-3-4.descripcion: A net with soil and aquatic plants on it covers a 10-foot pit dug into the bottom of a body of water.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 to remove the net
datos.reinicio: Others can fall into the pit, but the net entangles only the first creature to trigger the trap. The net must be reset manually.

butterfly-s-breath-trap-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-12: Negotiations for the Star Gun
butterfly-s-breath-trap-1-2.descripcion: A sickly-sweet perfume wafts through the air outside the council building, assaulting the senses of all that inhale it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 17 to hold your breath through the perfume, Occultism DC 16 (trained) to draw a warding rune in the air to disperse the poison, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the poison

camazotz-s-swarm.descripcion: A massive swarm of bats flies throughout the room, hampering vision, attacking foes, and magically restoring Camazotz's followers.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 17 (trained) to disperse the swarm or Religion DC 15 (trained) to disrupt Camazotz's connection, which disperses the swarm
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The swarm uses its first action to move up to 30 feet to envelop as many enemies as possible within its 30-foot burst space. All enemies in the swarm's space become Dazzled while within the swarm. It then uses its second action to bite all enemies, dealing 1d6+3 piercing damage (basic Reflex DC 17 save) to all enemies in the space.
datos.reinicio: The swarm disperses and returns to roost throughout the room 1 minute after all enemies leave the room. The swarm recovers 5 Hit Points per day thanks the power of Camazotz.

carved-mourner.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
carved-mourner.descripcion: The carving weeps. Its tears turn to a mist that covers the halls.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 17 (trained) to recite prayers for the dead, or Dwarven-lore DC 14 to speak the history of Raseri Kanton, or Thievery DC 20 to plug the holes in the carving
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

datos.desactivar: A hero must succeed at a Thievery DC 18 check on the triggering floor tiles or the wall sockets in the western wall.
datos.reinicio: The central spears reset after 1 minute.

chaotic-door-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-09: The Seven Secrets of Dacilane Academy
chaotic-door-1-2.descripcion: The frame splinters as the door flings open, the force hitting those nearby.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 17 (trained) to hold the door shut against the force, or Thievery DC 18 (trained) to deftly relieve pressure from the door.

churning-lava-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-19: Enter the Pallid Peak
churning-lava-1-2.descripcion: The equilibrium of the brown mold and lava river is disturbed, creating bubbles of molten stone that burst and spew burning debris.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 14 or Survival DC 14 or Thievery DC 17 to clear your square and all adjacent squares of the mold; the churning lava does not target creatures in cleared squares with its spatter attack, but the hazard is not destroyed until every square has been cleared of mold.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On the its initiative, the churning lava targets a random creature in the area with a ranged spatter attack as a magma bubble bursts.
datos.reinicio: If not completely destroyed, the mold spreads to one additional square within 10 feet of lava each day until it fully regenerates and regains its state of equilibrium. If every square is cleaned of mold, the hazard is destroyed.

cold-spot.descripcion: The temperature suddenly drops as spectral forces gather in the area.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 19 (trained) to banish the cold spot with ritual prayers or Occultism DC 20 (trained) to foil the arrival of outside forces
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

collapsing-cabinet-1-2.descripcion:
Fluids from leaking beakers have eaten nearly through the supports holding up this cabinet.

This Broken Threshold for this trap is 5, not 10.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 (trained) to gently place something under the cabinet to support its weight.

collapsing-ceiling-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave
collapsing-ceiling-1-2.descripcion: The damaged ceiling is the only thing stopping the centipedes lairing above from falling through.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 19 (trained) to reinforce the ceiling with boards from the broken door.

collapsing-debris.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers
collapsing-debris.descripcion: The room initially appears merely dilapidated, but on closer inspection it is positively liable to collapse at any moment.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 20 (untrained) to safely shore up the weaknesses in the masonry by replacing rotten wood with other assorted bric-a-brac, Thievery DC 17 (trained) to carefully place boards and the like to create bridges over structurally weak areas.

collapsing-porch.descripcion: A section of splintery and rotten floorboards drop a creature 6 feet onto uneven rocks and piercing shards of wood.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 15 (trained) to replace or cover the weak sections of flooring, or Survival DC 15 (trained) to crumble the rotten floorboards from a safe distance
datos.reinicio: Once this section of the porch has collapsed, creatures can still fall through the hole until the porch is Repaired.

cooking-disaster.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-18: Dacilane Academy's Delightful Disaster
cooking-disaster.descripcion: Skillet sputter and pots threaten to boil over, splashing their contents onto careless cooks or kitchen counters. The counters are covered with small dishes ready to add, along with 3 heavy cookbooks and a healthy coating of flour.

datos.desactivar: Cooking-lore DC 14 (trained) or Crafting DC 17 to add the proper ingredients to finish the dish. Diplomacy DC 17 or Occultism DC 17 to communicate with students when to stir or adjust the heat on a dish. Each disable attempt requires two actions, and three successful checks are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap uses each of its actions to make a splatter attack against a random creature in the kitchen. The trap never targets a student, as they are out of phase with it. For every successful disable attempt on the trap, it loses an action.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates after 1 minute, destroying all of the food. If left untouched, it resets automatically in 24 hours.

creeping-slime.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-22: Doom of Cassomir
creeping-slime.descripcion: The thick green slime has been imbued with foul hag magic, making it cling to and grow over living creatures that touch it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to carefully push the slime away without causing it to grow, Crafting DC 17 (one action) to neutralize it with alchemical reagents, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 15 [DC 18 in Subtier 3-4]) to counteract the magic animating it. Casting a 1st-rank or higher spell with the water trait washes away the slime.

dart-launcher.descripcion: A series of hidden launch tubes fire toxic darts at a 5-foot square.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 16 (trained)

deadfall-trap-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-04: Bandits of Immenwood
deadfall-trap-1-2.descripcion: A large tree has been cut down and supported only by a rope.

debris-storm.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-02: The East Hill Haunting
debris-storm.descripcion: Magical sensors detect when a creature enters the chamber.

fate-of-the-iomedaeans.descripcion: From within his sword prison, Meloth unleashes a malign vision that accurately depict the fate of the Iomedaeans who explored this chamber six decades ago. As the PCs experience the vision, the ship shakes and lurches about.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 17 three times to oppose Meloth's influence and to purge the vision with prayer or Intimidation DC 20 to establish spiritual dominance over the vision; once disabled in either way, the vision plays out to the end but has no detrimental effects on the PCs from that point forward (although the imps still manifest at the start of round 4 to attack the PCs).
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Each round, the Fate of the Iomedaeans trap takes a different action, as detailed below.
Round 1 Illumination returns to the ship chamber. The ship now rolls on a sea of hellfire, while burning clouds and red lightning fill the sky. Four ghostly humans—Iomedaeans all—appear on the main deck, two against the port rail and two near the prow, manipulating the crystal lens. Their leader stands next to the wheel in area B20, while the House of Secrets wizard who accompanies them is up in the crow's nest. He has the irezoko tattooed on his face, a different design than the one on Sarnax's statues, but definitely in the same tradition. Each PC must succeed at a Reflex DC 17 save or be knocked Prone by the rolling motion of the ship.
Round 2 The ship rolls more violently on the sea of fire. Each PC must succeed at a Reflex DC 17 save or be knocked Prone. Those who critically fail are thrown overboard and appear to burn to ashes in the sea of fire (in actuality, they are merely tossed overboard and fall 15 feet to the floor below in area B12, taking normal falling damage). A PC can attempt a Reflex DC 15 save to  to prevent this fall by clinging to a ship's railing.
Round 3 The phantom image of a vordine devil appears in a cloud of brimstone at the center of the deck, just aft of the main mast. The PCs can smell the brimstone, but the devil itself appears ephemeral, like the Iomedaeans. The armored clerics begin drawing weapons and casting spells. The PCs cannot directly interact with these figures, but the manifestation of the devil is unsettling—all PCs in the area must succeed at a Will DC 17 save to avoid becoming Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure); this is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.
Round 4 At the start of this round, Meloth unleashes a gang of imps from the dimensional prison within Meloth's Lifedrinker, controlling them to roll up over both sides of the ship and onto the main deck. The imps roll initiative and join the encounter, attacking the PCs and ignoring the illusions. The two clerics manipulating the prow lens yell at the wizard in the crow's nest. "The lens is powering the ship's phase spike! How can we travel without the helm? How do we make it stop?" they plead. The ship rolls again, this time in the opposite direction. One of the Iomedaeans at the rail spills over the side, vanishing in hellfire. The vordine takes advantage of her companion's distraction and runs another Iomedaean through, killing her with a single blow of its jagged glaive. Two of the imps cast invisibility and then fly over to land next to a different PC in hopes of stinging them the next round. The other two imps each attempt to cast charm on a different PC, then Fly into positions above those PCs. At the end of the round, each PC must succeed at a Reflex DC 17 save or be knocked Prone (but without the danger of being thrown overboard this time). The two imps who cast invisibility must also attempt this save to avoid being knocked prone; the flying imps take 1d6+3 bludgeoning damage from being battered by the mast, rigging, railing, or other portions of the ship (basic Reflex DC 17 save).
Round 5 The ship rights itself again, and the vordine closes with the two clerics at the bow. From the crow's nest, the wizard blasts a bolt of lightning at the devil. The vordine deflects the spell with a casual wave of its claw (a dramatic flourish added by Meloth), and an electric shock surges through the planks of the main deck to arc through the rigging. Each PC and each imp takes 1d6+3 electricity damage (basic Reflex DC 17 save). During this round, all the imps land and attack different PCs.
Round 6 The vordine kills both of the Iomedaeans near the crystal lens. From the crow's nest, the wizard screams at the Iomedaean leader, who still attends the wheel. Black smoke pours from her mouth and eyes. PCs who succeed at a Perception DC 20 check notice a shadowy, winged, one-eyed form looming over her, whispering into her ear (a shadowy manifestation of Meloth himself). She deliberately turns the wheel sharply, pitching the Provarion forward desperately, resulting in another violent shift akin to the one that occurs on round 2 (potentially throwing PCs and imps overboard).
Round 7 The vordine translocates from the ship's bow up into the crow's nest. The wizard's screams are cut off as the devil lops off his head, which topples down to the main deck, taking two awkward bounces before landing at the feet of a PC (if possible, a PC with the Mystery Adept background). That PC sees the wizard's lips move and believes the head is mouthing a threat of "I see ye!" The PC must attempt a Will DC 17 save to avoid becoming Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 and Fleeing as long as they remain frightened on a critical failure); a PC who has the Read Lips feat realizes that instead the wizard was mouthing a hopeless cry of "Save me!" and automatically gets a success on the Will save.
Round 8 The vordine translocates down to the ship's wheel. The phantom figure behind the Iomedaean leader vanishes like smoke (assuming the PCs ever saw it in the first place) as the devil appears in its place. As the vordine runs the leader through from behind, killing her with his trident, the devil seems to look directly into the eyes of each observer. Each PC must attempt a Will DC 17 save to avoid becoming Doomed 1; this has the emotion, fear, mental, and visual traits.
Round 9 The haunt ends, but the imps continue to fight to the death if any still live.

faulty-rockslide-trap.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-10: Delve the Pallid Depths
faulty-rockslide-trap.descripcion: The unstable rocks on the floor shift when stepped on, triggering rocks in the pile above to fall down across the pathway.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 17 (trained) to navigate a save path or Thievery DC 17 (trained) to bolster the rocks on the floor so they don't shift under a creature's weight. Two successful checks are necessary to ensure the route through the precarious pile of rocks is safe. Attempting each check requires two actions.

faulty-tidal-controls.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
faulty-tidal-controls.descripcion: Sigils carved into the turquoise sphere atop the altar illuminate. Moments later, a rush of water flows into the hallway.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 17 (trained) to neutralize the tidal magic, or Survival DC 17 to predict the changing tides, or Thievery DC 20 (trained) to scratch away the sigils; two total successes are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The magic controlling the tides malfunctions, causing the tides to change every few seconds. Water flows rapidly between areas B2 and B4. Each creature in area B2, area B4, or the hallway connecting them must attempt a Fortitude DC 17 save as the shifting tides buffet them, dealing 1d8 bludgeoning damage.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 5 feet along with the water.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 10 feet along with the water.

fiendish-hospitality.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-20: The Strings of Hell
fiendish-hospitality.descripcion: A haunting voice from the statue of a woman in servant's garb calls out to those in sight, welcoming them to stay. The statue then changes to the image of a gylou devil.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 14 (trained) to disrupt the unholy energy projecting from the statue, Athletics DC 17 to knock the statue off balance Three total successes using either skill disables the hazard.
datos.rutina: (two actions) For its first action, the statue uses handmaiden's command. With its second action, it makes a stony tentacle Strike at the closest target within range; if there are no targets, the trap instead uses handmaiden's command again.
datos.reinicio: The statue returns to its human visage once no creatures are in the courtyard and it resets after  rounds. Until it resets, a creature can destroy the statue with a Athletics DC 16 check, permanently disabling the hazard.

fire-sentry.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-06: Struck by Shadows
fire-sentry.descripcion: A 5-foot burst pillar of magical fire travels along a track throughout the room. The pillar emits bright light out to 20 feet.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 20 (trained) or Thievery DC 20 (trained) once on the control panel deactivates the whole trap, or Thievery DC 17 (trained) twice on the track prevents the pillar from moving. Each check requires two actions.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The pillar Strides, following the track in the room. If the trap's track is broken, the pillar can still Stride, but its Speed is only 10 feet. The pillar cannot move at all if the track is destroyed. When the pillar moves, it deals 1d6+3 fire damage to any creatures whose space it moves through.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates once it no longer detects the presence of creatures in the room.

firespark-trap-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
firespark-trap-1-2.descripcion: Magical motion sensors detect when a creature enters the chamber.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to disable the sensor without triggering them, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the sensors
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 10 minutes.

flames-of-verakivhan-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-18: The Fanciful March of Urwal
flames-of-verakivhan-3-4.descripcion: The demon lord Urxehl manifests upon Golarion a small region of his Abyssal realm, filled with constantly burning forests lashed by fierce storms and unholy rain that only further feeds the flames. This is a mystical fire, fueled by the presence of Urxehl's minions. Any flames on the map emit concealing smoke in a 10-foot radius around the fire.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 17 or Performance DC 17 (trained) to remind the Finadar forest of its true self; or Religion DC 17, Occultism DC 17, or Demon Lore(trained) to disrupt the connection to the imposed realm and extinguish one of the five sections of flames on the map. These checks can only be attempted by creatures adjacent to the section, and each attempt takes 2 actions. An extinguished fire still emits concealing smoke for 1 additional round but is no longer hot enough to deal damage. A Dispel Magic spell or a spell with the water trait (2nd level; counteract DC 15) extinguishes a section of flames. If the PCs disable three of the five sections of the flames of Verakivhan, the hazard is too weakened to sustain itself, and the remaining flames disappear. If there are no demons or elementals remaining in the area, the hazard is automatically disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Any creature within the flames takes 1d6+3 fire damage, and any creature adjacent to the flames takes 1d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 17 save). Additionally, the flames call down a fiery rain that deals 1d6+3 fire damage to a random PC within the planar overlay (basic Reflex DC 17 save). If any PCs attempted to disable the hazard that turn, the fiery rain chooses one of them as its target.

foot-pincer.descripcion: A metal pincer trap lies hidden at the bottom of a weakened spot in the floor.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 to jam the pincer's triggeer mechanism.
datos.reinicio: The foot pincer must be reset manually before it can activate again.

foretold-ruin-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-21: In Pursuit of Water
foretold-ruin-1-2.descripcion: Daemonic curses slither and crawl through malevolent runes carved in four stone pillars. HP is per-pillar.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to scratch out a pillar's runes, Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract a pillar's magic, or Athletics (Force Open) to push a pillar over. Disabling a pillar requires two actions. Disabling all four pillars or slaying Sezruth disables the trap
datos.rutina:
Routine (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled pillar. On its initiative, the trap uses each action to afflict a different non-evil creature in the room with thirst. The creature must attempt a Fortitude DC 17 save.

—

Critical Success The creature is temporarily immune to additional negative effects from the foretold ruin hazard's reaction for 24 hours. The hazard has no awareness of this immunity and continues to target this creature.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Fatigued until they drink water. If the creature was already fatigued, they take 1d6 nonlethal mental damage.

Critical Failure The creature is fatigued until they drink water and takes 1d6 nonlethal mental damage. If the creature was already fatigued, they instead take 2d6 nonlethal mental damage.

furnace-altar-mosaic.descripcion: The flames in a fifteen-foot-wide stained glass depiction of the religious symbol of Droskar are more than they seem.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) on the hidden hinge opens the mosaic panel, granting access to the shelves beyond while also disarming the trap
datos.reinicio: If the trap is triggered to do a Furnace Blast, it resets automatically at the start of the next round. If it's triggered to do a Cataclysmic Blast, it's destroyed and must be repaired.

grasping-limbs-3-4.descripcion: The limbs of smashed constructs line the bottom of the fissure, beneath the water. They desperately grab anything that gets too close.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) or Engineering Lore or Azlant Lore twice to immobilize the limbs, or Deception twice to trick the limbs into grasping each other.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The grasping limbs try to Grapple all creatures in the water (Athletics +9). They then tighten around all creatures they have grabbed or restrained, dealing 1d8 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 17).

hail-of-razor-stones.descripcion: When a concealed cord is tripped, several sharp stones fall onto the square containing the cord.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to safely cut the trip cord

hampering-web-troubles-in-grayce.descripcion: Semitransparent sheets of webbing are strategically placed in the basement, ready to capture small insects or hamper larger creatures that pass through.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 17 (trained) to dislodge a web

hands-of-slow-death.descripcion: A pile of dust and bone meal, several inches deep and 10 feet across on each side, blocks the tunnel to the surface. It is suffused with the despair of the slowly dying, and summons vengeful skeletal hands to hunt down anyone who dares attempt to leave the area.

datos.desactivar:
Religion DC 15 (trained) to speak the proper burial rites, Occultism DC 15 (trained) to exorcise the lingering souls, or Intimidation DC 17 to scare the fearful souls away.

These actions have the verbal trait. Each check to disable the hazard requires 2 actions, and two total successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (1 action) Spectral hands grasp at creatures in the area. Each creature within 30 feet of the dust pile takes 1d4 void damage (basic Will DC 17 save; creatures that critically fail this saving throw are Slowed 1 for 1 round).
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates if no creatures remain within 30 feet but resets immediately thereafter unless disabled. If tthe haunt is disabled, it resets after 24 hours.

haphazard-wood-pile.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
haphazard-wood-pile.descripcion: Beams of heavy and sharp wood rest against one another to form a precariously balanced cage tied to several trip lines and tension-bearing dowels.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained), Crafting DC 17 (trained), or Engineering-lore DC 17 (trained) to figure out how to safely dismantle the pile without it collapsing on anyone.

haunted-doll-cabinet.descripcion: Three shelves inside a dusty cabinet each hold a row of dolls infused with the Doll House's malevolent spiritual energy.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 16 (trained) or Religion DC 16 (trained) to calm the spirits of one of three shelves in the cabinet
datos.rutina: (3 actions) For each shelf that remains, the haunt takes 1 action to target a living, non-construct creature in the room. Phantom dolls escape from the cabinet to rush that creature, clamber over them, and punch, kick, and bite them. The target takes 1d6+2 spirit damage (basic Reflex DC 17 save).
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures have left the area or when the soulbound dolls in the northwestern cabinet are destroyed. After 1 hour, the haunt is ready to trigger again. Putting Thalleus's spirit to rest permanently destroys the haunt.

heavily-damaged-jaws-of-hell.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-06: Brastlewark at War Part 1: The Gnome Defection
heavily-damaged-jaws-of-hell.descripcion: The machine is a cylindrical device ringed in blades with a devilish eye at its center. Gnome inventors created the mechanical device, which taps into the planes of earth and fre to create powerful blasts to damage fortress walls or decimate ranks of enemies. Unfortunately, the many miles of forest have not been kind and it's malfunctioning. The damaged jaws planar connections have weakened to a mere trickle and, when activated, it lashes out in an uncontrolled frenzy. The blades encircling it begin lashing out.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 15, Crafting DC 15, Nature DC 15, or Thievery DC 15 (trained) twice, to sever the connection to the planes of fre and earth. Crafting DC 13 or Thievery DC 13 (trained) once, to remove the pintle connecting the limber to the horses. A creature must be adjacent to the jaws to make either check.
datos.rutina: (three actions) On its turn each round, the horses spend one action to move 30 feet, dragging the limber carrying the jaws behind them in a randomly chosen direction. The horses will not move through other creatures. Players on the limber when it moves must attempt a Acrobatics DC 15 check when it moves or fall of. Removing the pintle will end the random movement. The jaws use 2 actions to Spit Fire or make melee strikes against an adjacent creature.
datos.reinicio: The planar connection shuts down after 1 minute. The horses will tire and stop running after 1 minute.

hidden-crossbow-trap.fuente: Pathfinder Game Night: Dawn of the Frogs
hidden-crossbow-trap.descripcion: A crossbow hidden inside the frog skull connects to a floor tile in the center of the chamber.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to deactivate the pressure plate on the floor

hunted-by-duty-s-bonds.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
hunted-by-duty-s-bonds.descripcion: Shadowy chains reach out to ensnare creatures trapped in the mindscape.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 18 to avoid the chains, or Arcana DC 18, Occultism DC 18, or Religion DC 18 to ritually disrupt the haunting. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one. When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled and the Scaling the Chain haunt triggers.
datos.rutina: (two actions) Spectral chains snake out to wrap around three different random creatures trapped in the haunt, who must each succeed at a Reflex DC 17 save or have the Restrained condition until it {Escapes}. Each round that a creature starts its turn Grabbed, it takes 2d4+1 nonlethal force damage. Spectral scars form on any creature knocked Unconscious by this haunt.
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets the next time the Soulshackle traps creatures in the library.

infested-pit.descripcion: A thick sheet of webbing covers a 10-by-10-foot pit that's 20 feet deep, the top edge of which is protected by flame spraying pipes and the depths of which are infested with spiders.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 to obstruct the pipe's flow and prevent it from shooting out flames (a critical success causes the fire to backfire, making the pump device in area A16 explode and inflicting 4d6 fire damage [basic Reflex DC 20 save] to Shulgurk there).
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On the trap's initiative, Shulgurk manipulates his alchemical contraption in area A16 to spray fire across the pit at floor level. This spray of fire swiftly burns away the web floor, and any creature standing on it falls into the 20-foot-deep pit unless it Grabs an Edge with a successful Reflex DC 17 save. Creatures standing on the web floor or those located at floor level at the pit's entrance (including those that have Grabbed an Edge but have yet to move out of danger) take 1d6+3 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 17 save). Creatures adjacent to the pit to the north or south take 1d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 15 save). The spiders in the pit avoid exiting the pit entirely out of fear of the flames. Each time he triggers the flames, Shulgurk, delighted at the chaos, shouts gleeful insults through the pipes at the "pitiful wretches," certain that his "little friends" in the pit will take care of them well enough. "Devoured by spiders," he cackles. "A fitting end for insignificant insects!"
Each time this trap takes its action for the round, it diminishes the supply of alchemist's fire in one of the jugs attached to the infernal machine in area A16 by one use; after 3 rounds (and thus after one of the machine's three jugs is emptied), Shulgurk ceases to use the trap, and it becomes inert.
datos.reinicio: Shulgurk can refill one jug with specially formulated alchemist's fire once per day.

junk-launcher.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
junk-launcher.descripcion: A miniature makeshift catapult launches a mound of junk when a creature triggers the trip wire.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to disable the catapult without triggering the trap

lightning-strikes-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need
lightning-strikes-1-2.descripcion: The air grows thick as the Planes of Metal and Air both bleed into the swamp once again. A small fissure opens, causing static electricity to build and, fueled by the increased presence of metal in the area, sparks begin to fly. Electrical discharges begin to break out reaching from objects to unlucky creatures.

datos.desactivar: Arcana,nature,thievery DC 15 (trained) two times to counter the planar energies.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) On its turn each round, the electrical discharge randomly targets two creatures dealing 2d4 electricity damage. A targeted creature must attempt a basic Reflex DC 15 save.

livid-victims.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-99: Under the Eye of the Mantis
livid-victims.descripcion: The souls of the ghouls' recent meals cry out from their pile of bones in the nearby tunnel, lamenting their fate.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 14 (trained) sets the spirits at ease, or Deception DC 17, Diplomacy DC 17, or Intimidation DC 17 to convince the spirits to not interfere right now. A single success disables the haunt. PCs may accrue additional successes beyond the first—each one convinces the haunt to use telekinetic interference once against ghouls in the haunt's range instead of the living creatures.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The haunt uses one action to activate its gurgling gasp and then uses telekinetic interference for all of its other actions until it can use gurgling gasp again.

lyzerium-bottles.fuente: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
lyzerium-bottles.descripcion: Five tiny glass bottles, each full of volatile green liquid, are discretely positioned around the room. Each bottle explodes when its glass is broken.

datos.desactivar: Interact action to pick up one of the five bottles.

mud-pot.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-10: Delve the Pallid Depths
mud-pot.descripcion: Solid ground gives way to a lake of bubbling mud that burns anyone who enters and routinely belches out sulfur.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 17 (trained) to find and remove the stones blocking the flow of water to the mud pot. The water decreases the viscosity of the mud, allowing steam and sulfur to escape gradually, rather than in violent bursts, so creatures can pass through unharmed. The hazard requires two successful checks to disable. Attempting the check takes two actions.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the mud pot belches a cloud of sickening sulfur into the small cavern. Creatures other than sulfuric slimes within 10 feet must succeed at a Fortitude DC 16 save or be exposed to sulfur poisoning.

ornery-augdunars.descripcion: Spooked augdunars gallop wildly about the paddock, biting and kicking as they run.

datos.desactivar: Succeed at four of the following checks in any combination: Nature DC 14 (trained) to calm the animals, Intimidation DC 16 (untrained) to scare the augdunars away, Will DC 18 (trained) to avoid flinching and project confidence, causing the augdunars to veer away. For each success, the hazard takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The augdunars use an action to Strike one target with their jaws, and they use another action to Trip a different target (Athletics +9). If the augdunars have taken damage since their last turn, they instead use Lashing Hooves with their first action and then make either a jaws Strike or Trip attempt with their second action.

pile-of-orts.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-01: Intro to the Year of Battle's Spark: Enough is Enough
pile-of-orts.descripcion: A rift to Hell crackles with unstable energy from the broken summoning circle as a squirming mass of fiends struggles to emerge A blood mist projection of a Hellknight angrily commands them.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 16, Nature DC 16, Occultism DC 16, or Religion DC 16 (2 actions) (trained) while within 15 feet to weaken the rift, dealing 2d4 spirit damage to it. This damage has the holy trait.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The Hellknight commands the orts, and the trap lashes out at each enemy creature in its space and adjacent, dealing 1d6+3 slashing damage (basic Reflex DC 15 save) If no enemy is in reach, an ort emerges in an adjacent square.

poisoned-dart-trap-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
poisoned-dart-trap-1-2.descripcion: Poisoned darts fire from recesses in the walls when a creature steps on a pressure plate.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disable the pressure plate
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 2 rounds. After 5 total attacks, it runs out of poisoned darts.

poisonous-atmosphere.descripcion: Aucturn's poisonous, magical atmosphere has strange effects on the planet's creatures.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) or Occultism DC 20 (trained) to breathe pockets of safe air trapped in bags and clothing
datos.rutina: (1 action; illusion, mental, occult) The atmosphere continues to affect all creatures in the area, requiring a new Fortitude save each round against its Poisonous Atmosphere. A creature holding its breath gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the save.

port-peril-bar-fight-last-catch-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #4: Port Peril Pub Crawl
port-peril-bar-fight-last-catch-1-2.descripcion: An assorted crowd throws punches, flings bottles, and otherwise flies into chaos as a bar fight breaks out, clustering in six sections of one of Port Peril's drinking houses.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 17 to cow a section of crowd or Diplomacy DC 20 to attempt to disperse it
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The bar fight uses its first action to make a general mayhem Strike against all creatures in any area that has not been disabled. Make one Strike against each enemy in the area and roll the damage only once for all targets. The bar fight then uses its second action to use Port Peril specialty.

port-peril-bar-fight-rivanti-s-bar-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #4: Port Peril Pub Crawl

precarious-thunderstone-trap.descripcion: A tripwire fastened to the gate snaps when the gate is opened, releasing a moderate thunderstone to the ground.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 (trained) to remove the thunderstone or Reflex DC 18 save to catch the falling thunderstone

pressurized-bottle-1-2.descripcion: One of the potions has decayed, putting it under immense pressure. Its contents have become poisonous. When handled improperly, the bottle bursts, sending glass shards flying everywhere.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to carefully place the bottle under a bucket or bowl.

puzzle-gate.descripcion: This complicated lock requires solving five puzzles in quick succession.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 44 (master) to  the gate, Crafting DC 41 or Thievery DC 41 (expert) twice to dismantle the puzzle lock, or Games Lore DC 34 (expert) or Society DC 36 (expert) five times to solve the puzzles
datos.rutina: The puzzle makes an electroshock Strike against two different creatures.
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets after 1 minute if even one puzzle remains unsolved. The hazard doesn't reset if the gate is destroyed.

quagmire.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-08: Revolution on the Riverside
quagmire.descripcion: A patch of treacherous bog attempts to submerge creatures that step onto it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 15 (trained) to disturb the surface and make the quagmire plainly visible
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the quagmire pulls each creature within it 1 square toward the center of the quagmire and 1 step further submerged; a creature that is submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that is submerged up to its neck is pulled under and has to hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature in the quagmire can attempt a Athletics DC 17 check to Swim to either raise itself by 1 step if its submerged to its neck or worse, or to swim out of the quagmire if its submerged up to only its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down 1 step. A creature that Swims out of the quagmire escapes the hazard and is Prone adjacent to the quagmire. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar tool, or attempt to pull a creature within their reach out with a Athletics DC 17 check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check.
datos.reinicio: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 24 hours

raging-forest-fire.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-15: The Blooming Catastrophe
raging-forest-fire.descripcion: A fire engulfs a 10-foot-by-10-foot section of forest, then spreads on each of its turns.

datos.desactivar:
A successful Athletics DC 15, Nature DC 15, or Survival DC 15 check from an adjacent square is sufficient to smother one 5-foot-square of fire; each attempt is an Interact action. Dousing the flames automatically extinguishes one or more sections of fire, with no check. Water typically clears a 5-foot square if the amount is small (such as that from Create Water or Hydraulic Push). Larger amounts of water, such as a full bucket, typically douse a 10-foot-by-10-foot area (or 4 squares in some other shape). Throwing a bucket of water on flames requires an Interact action. A Waterskin doesn't contain enough water to put out even 1 square of fire.

Cold can also put out fire, but only if the cold can affect an area; cold is usually less effective than water, so a Frost Vial typically puts out only 1 square of fire, and Ray of Frost is ineffective.
datos.rutina: On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies, minimum 1 square. The GM determines the squares the fire spreads into. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes 1d6 fire damage, and any creature within the flames takes 4d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 15 save for both). A creature can take damage from flames only once per round.

reflected-desires.descripcion: This mirror reflects the viewer's deepest desires.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to shroud the mirror without looking at it, or Occultism DC 17 (trained) to erect mental barriers
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 round.

ritual-backlash.descripcion: The space above the flame in the ivory bowl wavers and the smell of brimstone assaults the senses.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 20 or Religion DC 20 three times to suppress the backlash of energy, or defeat Viro Ahala
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The hazard makes a ranged mindburn Strike, creates a Pulse of Fear, and bestows Vitality of Hell to Viro or one of his allies at random. If it's reduced to 2 actions, the hazard doesn't create a Pulse of Fear. If reduced to 1 action, the hazard only bestows Vitality of Hell.
datos.reinicio: Once Viro Ahala has been defeated, this trap can't be reset.

rusted-cage-trap.descripcion: A rusty cage embedded in the ceiling drops down with a clang to try to entrap a creature that steps onto the pressure plate in the middle of the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 13 to harmlessly trigger the trap by nudging the pressure plate, Thievery DC 20 to stabilize the pressure plate so it doesn't trigger, or Athletics DC 20 to Escape from the cage or Force Open the cage once it falls
datos.reinicio: The mechanism to manually reset this trap is located in area D15.

sailor-s-warning-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
sailor-s-warning-1-2.descripcion: An illusory cyclops in oracular robes cries out a warning, but then dissolves into a violent phantasmal cyclops, which calls out for the Blind Formless Chaos That Lies Behind the Stars to accept his sacrifice. It then plunges an obsidian athame into a creature's chest, summoning a foul entity.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 14 (trained) to repair Chamenaiti's magic, Religion DC 17 or Occultism DC 17 (trained) to offset the prayer, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 14) to counteract the warning
datos.rutina: a Rubbery crimson tentacles appear from a rip in the air and grasp at all creatures in the area, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 17 save).

shadow-double-runes-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro: Year of Shattered Sanctuaries
shadow-double-runes-3-4.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 10-foot radius surrounds a shadowy 3-foot-diameter rune on the floor.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 14 (trained) to carefully erase the rune without triggering the sensors, Dispel Magic or a spell with the Light trait (1st level; counteract DC 15) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each night at dusk.

shadowshift-field.descripcion: Cross-planar seepage from the Oaksteward rebels' ritual causes shadowy warping effects to strain and damage living creatures in the forest clearing.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 17 (trained) to will the Material Plane's hold on the area back into firmness and disable the effect for 1 hour, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to end the effect permanently
datos.rutina:
Each creature in the clearing must attempt a Fortitude DC 17 save as the planar warping threatens to create microscopic tears inside their body. Fey, plant creatures, and druids are unaffected.

—
Critical Success As success, and the creature is healed by the primal magic, regaining 1d6 healing Hit Points.
Success The creature is unaffected and immune to the effect for 24 hours.
Failure The creature takes 1d6+3 force damage.
Critical Failure The creature takes 2d6+6 force damage.
datos.reinicio: This effect continues for 1 day, after which it ends and cannot be triggered again without another ritual.

shaitan-tactics-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
shaitan-tactics-3-4.descripcion: The shaitan observes the area from a distance, observing the battlefield as a game board. The ground trembles in response to the genie's enthusiasm.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 20 (trained) or Nature DC 20 (trained) to contest the shaitan's control (requires two successes).
datos.rutina: (2 actions) On each of the trap's actions, the trap either moves a willing creature on the ground up to 30 feet without provoking reactions or makes a hostile creature on the ground Off-Guard for 1 round on a failed Acrobatics DC 20 check or Reflex DC 20 save.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets once all hostile creatures leave A3 or surrender.

shattered-window.descripcion: The anger trapped within a structure shatters a window, showering glass in adjacent spaces.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 19 or Religion DC 19 (trained) to suppress the spiritual energy or Diplomacy DC 20 (trained) to soothe the latent anger

singe-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
singe-1-2.descripcion: Singe's spirit lingers in the Whippoorwill's crow's nest, where it calls out warnings and shoots intruders.

datos.desactivar: Pathfinder-society-lore DC 17 (trained) to persuade Singe that you are Pathfinders or Religion DC 17(trained) to perform rites to lay Singe to rest; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: d Singe uses its first action(s) to make a long gun Strike against a random creature in the area. It uses its final action for Lookout's Warning. If the PCs successfully use Pathfinder Society Lore to Disable the haunt, Singe loses an action to make a long gun Strike.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

slamming-door.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-20: The Strings of Hell
slamming-door.descripcion: Pressure-sensitive panels in the floor connect to a stone slab hidden in a hallway's ceiling.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 (trained) on the floor panels before the slab falls
datos.reinicio: Once this trap is triggered, the area of the fallen slab is greater difficult terrain until the trap is reset, which requires 1 hour of labor.

slamming-door-bb.fuente: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star
slamming-door-bb.descripcion: Pressure-sensitive panels in the floor connect to a stone slab hidden in a hallway's ceiling.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 on the floor panels before the slab falls.

slamming-gate.descripcion: The heavy gate slams shut when opened more than halfway

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 (trained) to loosen the gate's springs before it slams closed
datos.reinicio: The trap can be reactivated (or deactivated, if it's active) by flipping a lever hidden in the nearby wall. A character Searching the area finds it with a successful Perception DC 18 check.

sliding-statue-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-09: The Seven Secrets of Dacilane Academy
sliding-statue-1-2.descripcion: With a rumble, this statue of a former Pathfinder slides across the schoolyard. Its legs pump up and down as it advances.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 20 to hold it back, Crafting DC 17 (trained) to break the statue by exploiting a flaw, Occultism DC 16 (trained) to dispel the planar energies.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap uses its three actions for its Trample activity.

somewhat-haunted-hollows.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-99: Under the Eye of the Mantis
somewhat-haunted-hollows.descripcion: The spirits of innumerable dryads and peaceful wood elementals, ripped from their bodies as they were turned into furniture, writhe and seethe, lashing out at both living and undead alike.

datos.desactivar:
Diplomacy DC 14 (trained), Nature DC 14 (trained), or Religion DC 14 (trained) to set the spirits to rest or Deception DC 17, Intimidation DC 17, or Occultism DC 17 to convince the spirits that their eternal rest is coming soon.
A PC may make a Strike against AC 13 to destroy a single table or chair in the room, this functions as a successful check to Aid another PC attempting to disable the haunt; two total successes are required to disable the haunt. If all of the tables and chairs are destroyed, the haunt is temporarily disabled until dawn of the next day.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The Haunted Hollows haunt uses table flip or chair toss Strikes at different creatures in the area, favoring those who are trying to disable the haunt first, but otherwise choosing randomly. The table flip Strikes originate with any table in the room, destroying the table in the process. The chair toss Strikes originate with any chair or bar stool in the room, destroying that object in the process. If the haunt is not disabled, these objects reform and return to their original positions at dawn of the next day.

spell-pitchers.descripcion: A large pitcher plant occupying a 5-foot space sits seemingly dormant with its dull petals open.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 15 (trained) to safely trigger the plant's reflexes, causing it to close and become dormant for one day, or Nature DC 17 (trained) to carefully coax the pitcher into quiescence
datos.reinicio: Once the pitcher has eaten a spell, its petals turn dark pink and green before it closes. It goes dormant for one day per spell rank of the spell consumed. Once the pitcher finishes digesting, it opens again and slowly wilts. A second pitcher branches into an adjacent square when the first pitcher opens again.

spiked-walls.descripcion: A low trip wire connects to a lattice panel covered with wooden spikes.

datos.desactivar: {Thievery} (trained) to snip the trip wire or jam the panel

spiky-pit-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales
spiky-pit-1-2.descripcion: A wooden trapdoor covers a pit that's 10 feet square and 20 feet deep.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 to remove the trapdoor
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

spinning-juice-fountain.descripcion: The enchanted fountain spews large quantities of grape juice as its marble tiers spin with increasing speed, flinging juice in all directions.

datos.desactivar:
Athletics DC 16 to Grapple a tier and halt its momentum, followed by Crafting DC 14 or Thievery DC 14 (while the tier is grabbed) to disable the pump mechanism through the gap that the previous checks left open. Grappling a tier requires 1 action. Each Crafting or Thievery check to disable a tier is a 2-action activity.

The fountain has three tiers, and fully disabling the fountain requires each tier to be disabled. For each disabled tier, the DC's to Grapple or disable another tier decrease by 2. If the creature critically succeeds at a check to disable a tier, it's immediately disabled, regardless of the number of checks that would otherwise be required due to Challenge Point adjustments.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The fountain accelerates its spinning, spraying juice 10 feet in all directions on its first turn, 15 feet in all directions on its second turn, and 20 feet in all directions on its third turn. Every square where it sprays juice becomes difficult terrain. At the start of its fourth turn, the fountain breaks, disabling the hazard and flinging juice 25 feet in all directions.

spore-spears.descripcion: A large patch of moss ripples like the surface of a pond as spears of green plant matter jut outward.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 17 or Occultism DC 17 twice to cut off the unstable connection to the Plane of Wood, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the planar magic
datos.rutina: (2 actions) For each action, the moss pond makes a spore spear Strike against a random non-plant creature on or within 10 feet of the moss pond.
datos.reinicio: If the trap isn't disabled, it becomes dormant for 10 minutes if there are no creatures on or within 10 feet of the moss patch at the start of its turn.

spreading-fire.descripcion: A fire engulfs a 5-foot-by-5-foot area, then spreads on each of its turns.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 17 to splash the barrels of gall ink on the fire or Survival DC 15 to smother the flames
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies, with a minimum of 1 square. You determine the squares the fire spreads into—typically those with the most flammable materials. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes 1d6 fire damage, and any creature within the flames takes 4d6 fire damage. Both of these have a basic Reflex DC 17 save. A creature can take damage from flames only once per round.

stinging-nettles.descripcion: This bright green plant has long triangular leaves covered with fine hair-like stingers.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 17 to carefully navigate the plant and pull aside or cut away the nettles

submerged-shard.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-12: The Burden of Envy
submerged-shard.descripcion: An immense, jagged piece of clear crystal 10 feet square and forty feet high juts up from the seafloor

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 13 (trained) to blunt the crystal's edges without getting cut
datos.reinicio: The hazard still damages any creature or object that enters its space, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 1 minute.

summoning-rune-pfs-1-11.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-11: Flames of Rebellion
summoning-rune-pfs-1-11.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors covers four squares on the map. One of these hazards is in the squares directly above each of the four yellow runes on the map, and the other is in the squares directly above each of the four blue runes on the map.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 15 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 17 (trained) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

talhindir-s-grief.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
talhindir-s-grief.descripcion: Gentle crying rises to become overwhelming wails. The fungal carvings begin to weep blood that pools around the pillars

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 17 (trained) to overpower the frightening cries with a greater sound or Occultism DC 15 or Religion DC 15 (trained) to ritually disrupt the haunting.
datos.reinicio: If the haunt is not dispersed, it resets after 1 day.

tilting-floor.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
tilting-floor.descripcion: The floor wobbles with each step.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 to prop up the floor, or Crafting DC 17 (trained) to reinforce subflooring
datos.reinicio: immediate

tok-s-trap.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-07: Sewer Dragon Crisis
tok-s-trap.descripcion: This basic trap is little more than a snare designed to slow down and distract enemies.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18

tok-s-trap-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-07: Sewer Dragon Crisis
tok-s-trap-3-4.descripcion: This basic trap is little more than a snare designed to slow down and distract enemies.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20

tombstone-door.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
tombstone-door.descripcion: A malfunction in the door's opening mechanism has caused unstable magic to pool within it, making it liable to release the sorrows it has collected from all who have mourned their lost homeland at its threshold.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 17 (trained) or Deception DC 20 to coax the door's magic into allowing access; the DC is reduced by 2 if someone in the room has said "Tar Khadurrm" in the last hour.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

town-hall-fire.descripcion: A fire engulfs the western door and a 10-foot-by-10-foot area immediately east of it, then spreads on each of its turns.

datos.desactivar:
Eliminating the hazard requires dousing the flames. Water typically clears a 5-foot square if the amount is small (such as that from Create Water or Hydraulic Push).
