Cold can also put out fire, but only if the cold can affect an area; cold is usually less effective than water, so a Frost Vial typically puts out 1 square of fire, and Ray of Frost is ineffective.

Fountain Circle, located outside town hall, has several working water pumps. These are far enough away that it's impractical for a PC to bring water back and forth. However, a PC might instruct the more steely nerved spectators to create a bucket brigade. It takes 15 spectators (which can include those rescued by councilors as well as by PCs) to set this up, and 2 rounds for the townspeople to line up and begin pumping water from Fountain Circle. As of the 3rd round, there is a bucket of water available for the PCs to use at the chamber's southern entrance at the beginning of each PC's turn. Members of a bucket brigade are lined up outside the chamber, and don't take damage from smoke inhalation.

If a PC does want to carry the water, it's 150 feet from the chamber's southern door to a pump, so it 6 actions are usually needed to reach the pumps or return. Filling a bucket requires an Interact action.

Other methods might also help control the fire, as you determine. For example, the PCs might be able to find something to barricade the fire with to control its path, or use a cloak to beat out some of the fire.

You determine the squares the fire spreads into-typically those with the most flammable materials. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes 1d6 fire damage, and any creature within the flames takes 4d6 fire damage. Both of these have a basic Reflex DC 17 save. A creature can take damage from flames only once per round. (For simplicity, track damage only for the NPCs and their allies, not for the spectators; Turn 5 and Turn 7 have instructions regarding the spectators' health).

The fire has an additional effect on each of its turns after the first.

Turn 2 The chamber's northern door flies open and flames burst through, igniting the 10-foot-by-10-foot area in front of the door. All fires spread on subsequent turns, at the same rate listed above. Any fires that join together become one fire for this purpose.

Turn 4+ Creatures in the room take 1d6 untyped damage from smoke inhalation at the ends of their turns. Anyone who uses an Interact action to tie a wet rag around their nose and mouth (or uses another creative solution) halves the damage.

Turn 5 Spectators still inside the room fall Unconscious from burns and smoke inhalation.

Turn 7 Spectators still in the room die.

trapmaster-tok-s-surprise-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales
trapmaster-tok-s-surprise-1-2.descripcion: Pressure sensitive panels in the floor connect to a barrel of debris hidden in the hallway's ceiling

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) on the floor panels before the barrel falls

trapped-gate.descripcion: A hair trigger rings an alarm and launches a small assortment of wooden spikes to impale anyone attempting to open the gate incorrectly.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 (trained) to disable the thin trigger that snaps when attempting to open the gate.

treasure-avalanche.descripcion: A large pile of treasure trembles precariously, threatening to collapse down into a crashing wave of coins and fine objects.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 16 (trained) to remove the right pieces from the treasure pile and induce a controlled collapse.

trip-wire.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
trip-wire.descripcion: Barbed wire stretches across the passageway at the perfect height to tear into ankles.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to detach the wire

unseen-arson-assistant.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-16: Dacilane Academy's First Great Prank War
unseen-arson-assistant.descripcion: Fire engulfs four 5-foot-by-5-foot sections of the library, then spreads erratically on each of its turns as burning books are carried about by the modified unseen servant.

datos.desactivar: A successful Athletics DC 15, Nature DC 15, or Survival DC 15 check from an adjacent square is sufficient to smother one 5-foot- square of fire; each attempt is an Interact action. Dousing the flames automatically extinguishes one or more sections of fire, with no check. Water typically clears a 5-foot square if the amount is small (such as that from Create Water or Hydraulic Push). Larger amounts of water, such as a full bucket, typically douse a 10-foot-by-10-foot area (or 4 squares in some other shape). Throwing a bucket of water on flames requires an Interact action. A waterskin doesn't contain enough water to put out even 1 square of fire. Cold can also put out fire, but only if the cold can affect an area; cold is usually less effective than water, so a Frost Vial typically puts out only 1 square of fire, and ray of frost is ineffective.
datos.rutina: On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies plus the number of books that the lurkers in light lit on fire this round, minimum 1 square. You determine the squares the fire spreads into, but any spread from lit books must affect a bookshelf; fires spread in this way do not need to spread into adjacent squares. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes 1d6 fire damage, and any creature within the flames takes 4d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 15 save for both). A creature can take damage from flames only once per round.

viper-urn.descripcion: A ceramic urn containing a coiled viper tips and shatters when a tripwire is pulled.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 (trained) to stabilize the urn, or Athletics DC 15 to carefully lower the heavy urn

wicked-reflection.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
wicked-reflection.descripcion: Ornate full-length mirrors with fiendish filigree depict the image of Fasiel ibn Sazadin in villainous triumph over his enemies.

datos.desactivar: Stealth DC 21 (trained) to approach a mirror without showing up in the reflection, followed by Thievery DC 19 to cover mirror or dispel magic (2nd level; counteract DC 19) to counteract the binding

wind-buffets-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need
wind-buffets-1-2.descripcion: The wind grows fierce as a small planar fissure opens, blowing around leaves and creatures alike.

datos.desactivar: Arcana,nature,thievery DC 15 (trained) two times to counter the planar energies.
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) On its turn each round, the wind begins blowing fiercely from a random direction. All creatures must attempt a Reflex DC 15 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is moved 5 feet in the direction the wind is blowing.
Failure The creature is moved 10 feet in the direction the wind is blowing and is knocked Prone.
Critical Failure The creature is moved 10 feet in the direction the wind is blowing, is knocked prone, and is Stunned 1.

a-broken-promise-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-02: Return to the Grave
a-broken-promise-1-2.descripcion: The grove, broken and tormented due to the necromantic energy infecting the area it protected, manifests an illusion to warn others of the region's plight and plead for help. Pharasmin cleric and Pathfinder Seldrick Dralston trudges into the grove, injured and infected with some kind of evil corruption. He defiles the statue of Erastil in the center of the grove, and the golden light illuminating the grove ceases, revealing the black skies above. Purple magical energy emanating from a nearby tower seeps into the sacred grove, and the life within the grove's protection begins to die.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 18 (trained) or Religion DC 18 (trained) to convince the spirit of the wood the message has been understood
datos.reinicio: The haunt returns every 10 minutes to retell its tale. The haunting of the sacred grove is permanently put to rest if the shrine is reconsecrated, which is impossible unless the evil forces in the nearby watchtower are defeated.

accursed-cargo-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
accursed-cargo-1-2.descripcion: A wooden crate bearing a chthonic sigil glows with a power contained within it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to open the crate with gradual release of its magical energy, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 15) to dispel the rune

ancient-apparatus.descripcion: A complex device made of multicolored metal that resembles a combination of grinding gears, spider-like legs, and twitching blades, from which emits a constant soft ticking sound. All of the metal in the device appears to be rusted or corroded.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 to adjust the device's workings so they seize up and no longer function, or Religion DC 21 to focus prayers to a non-evil deity into the device to disrupt its ability to channel ambient faith
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The ancient apparatus emits beams of rust-colored light, spending an action to make ranged Strikes against three targets in area D3. The apparatus can target creatures as if it possessed darkvision, but has no ability to discern between friend or foe. It can't target a creature more than once, and if there are more than three targets, it selects its targets from those it can see in the room randomly. The ancient apparatus has only 1 action as long as its Hit Points are below its BT.
datos.reinicio: The ancient apparatus reverts to its non-active mode and resets automatically at the end of any round in which there are no obvious targets to attack.

ascending-the-chain.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
ascending-the-chain.descripcion: The PCs appear on a gigantic wall of hooked chains dangling in a gray swirling mist. The chains radiate life-chilling energy Cries of innocence and condemnation echo through the mist in Elven. A plane of light 10 feet above eddies and swirls as it dully reflects the PCs below, but the reflections warp and alter the PCs to have sallow complexions like the undead.

datos.desactivar: A PC that has ascended to the plane of light (Athletics DC 15 check to Climb; on a critical failure, the PC falls 10 feet before being seized by a chain) can attempt a Thievery DC 20 check to disrupt the plane or a Arcana DC 20, Occultism DC 20 or Religion DC 20 check to ritually disrupt the haunting. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one. When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled and the PCs all return to area B3.
datos.rutina: (three actions) The chains rattle and sigh ominously around two different random creatures trapped in the haunt, dealing 2d6+2 void damage (basic Will DC 18 save).
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets the next time the Soulshackle traps creatures in the library.

automatic-fire-suppression-3-4.descripcion: Ceiling sprinklers spray in response to any fire in the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to jam the sprinkler system or Engineering Lore (trained) on the control panel on the north wall to turn the system off.

azlanti-elemental-nexus.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-02: The Blackwood Lost
azlanti-elemental-nexus.descripcion: A large cylindrical metallic structure surrounded by dense cables and pipes, anointed with mystical runes which glow and hum vibrantly. Elemental energy arcs off three spikes that may have once been connected to some of the cables.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 18 (trained) to restart the machine's connection to an elemental plane, or Thievery DC 21 (trained) to find and deactivate the whichever rune is currently active; three total successes are required to disable the nexus. A spike can be disabled with a Athletics DC 21 (trained) check to rip it from the structure or a Crafting DC 18 (trained) check to reconnect some of the cables. If all 6 elemental energies are returned to the nexus, it is disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The nexus spends each of its actions making an elemental wave Strike; each of these must be against a different creature who does not have the elemental trait. For each spike destroyed or disabled, the trap loses 1 action.

blood-shadow-mirror.descripcion: A dark shape moves in the surface of an ornate mirror, its eyes wide as blood seeps down its tormented face.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 16 (trained) to fully cover the mirror or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to dispel the mirror.
datos.rutina:
(2 actions; arcane, mental) The bloody figure in the mirror transforms to reflect a creature within 30 feet. The reflection bleeds profusely from the eyes, nose, and mouth, and the reflected creature must attempt a Will DC 18 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.
Success The creature bleeds from their mouth or nose.
Failure The creature bleeds from their eyes, mouth, and nose, and takes 1d10 persistent damage.
Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is Frightened 1.
datos.reinicio: 1 minute if no fresh blood has been spilled.

bloodthirsty-apparitions.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-04: An Enkindled Carnival
bloodthirsty-apparitions.descripcion: Deceased Puddles residents lash out at living creatures.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 15 (trained) three times to banish the apparitions with prayers, or Occultism DC 18 (trained) once to commune with the spirits and convince them to pass on
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt's screams send biting supernatural rain around the area, dealing 2d6+2 piercing damage to all living creatures within 90 feet (basic Reflex DC 18 save). Creatures who fail the save are Blinded by a red haze for 1 round.
datos.reinicio: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't reform 1 minute after the Puddles phantom is slain.

boiling-fountains.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
boiling-fountains.descripcion: Four pressure plates beneath the floorboards activate dragon-headed fountains on either side of the room, which spray boiling water across the area between them.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (trained) to disable each pressure plate, Thievery DC 16 to jam each fountain, or Thievery DC 18 to deflect a fountain's spray
datos.reinicio: Once a pressure plate has been activated, it must be reset manually.

coal-residue.descripcion: Combustible material can ignite and burn ferociously.

datos.desactivar: Mining-lore DC 15 (trained) to spread inert material over the area or Survival DC 18 to pry up enough of the material to prevent a chain reaction.

collapsing-floor--pathfinder-society-sce.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
collapsing-floor--pathfinder-society-sce.descripcion: Around the edges of the pit, more rotting boards are ready to give way.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 16 to reinforce the beams
datos.reinicio: As the damage to the floor spreads, the areas adjacent to the new pit become new areas of this hazard.

cordon-alarm.descripcion: A hempen rope tied between trees emanates an invisible, cylindrical barrier that sounds an alarm when crossed.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to move the rope without setting of the alarm, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 16) to disable the rope's magic
datos.reinicio: The alarm resets immediately. Multiple breaches can cause the alarm to sound in multiple places at the same time, though the alarm can still be triggered only once per round.

corpse-disposal.descripcion: A wooden trapdoor conceals a spike-filled pit 10 feet square and 20 feet deep. The DC to Climb out of the pit is Athletics DC 10.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to jam the trapdoor open

crowd-with-trash.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
crowd-with-trash.descripcion: The crowd is riled up enough to start throwing garbage at the interlopers, but not riled up enough to risk their lives. The crowd fills nine contiguous squares but can be shaped to fit the streets. Characters can move through the crowd, but spaces occupied by the crowd are difficult terrain.

datos.desactivar: After more people in the crowd have become shaken or taken damage than there are crowd leaders left standing, the crowd disperses. For abilities affecting an area, count each affected square as one member of the crowd.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The crowd uses its first action to Stride away from any opponent adjacent to them (or to get within 30 feet), then uses each remaining action to make a trash Strike at a different target.
datos.reinicio: After more people in the crowd have become shaken or taken damage than there are crowd leaders left standing, the crowd disperses. For abilities affecting an area, count each affected square as one member of the crowd.

crushing-crowd-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-01: Intro to the Year of Immortal Influence
crushing-crowd-1-2.descripcion: The crowd rushes forward, risking a stampede as everyone tries to fnd a safe exit.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 15 to calm the crowd, or Intimidation DC 18 or Society DC 18 to control the crowd's behavior
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the crowd moves 5 feet toward the exit in area A1, then crushes any creature in a 10-foot emanation, dealing 2d6+2 bludgeoning damage. All targets must attempt a basic Reflex DC 18 save.
Failure The target takes full damage and becomes Prone.
Critical Failure The target takes double damage, becomes prone, and is Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

decrepit-bridge.descripcion: The 30-foot-long, 10-foot-wide bridge groans under the weight of those who cross it.

dropping-web-trap.descripcion: A 30-foot-wide rope bridge spans a 30-foot‑deep chasm between two crags on the mountainside.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 15 or Thievery DC 18 to secure the bridge in place.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

entombed-spirit.descripcion: The wall bulges out in the shape of a howling humanoid face as it twists and forms tendrils reaching for nearby creatures. This haunt is formed when a murder victim is entombed within a wall before or after their death.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 17 (trained) to weaken the spirit, Athletics DC 18 (trained) to force the spirit's face back inside the wall, or Diplomacy DC 19 (trained) to talk down the spirit; two total successes across all skills are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The spirit attempts to Grapple up to two creatures within 10 feet with a +14 Athletics modifier, then squeezes each creature it has Grabbed, dealing 1d10+4 untyped damage. The haunt doesn't apply a multiple attack penalty to the second attempt to Grapple.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area and resets immediately thereafter. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is permanently destroyed if the remains of the deceased are removed from the wall.

envenomed-thorns-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On
envenomed-thorns-trap.descripcion: A trip wire strung 4 feet above the ground releases a branch studded with envenomed thorns.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to remove the trip wire.

exploding-statue.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
exploding-statue.descripcion: A hollow statue filled with explosives is connected to a trip wire running along the adjacent door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (trained) to safely cut the wire

explosive-barrels.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
explosive-barrels.descripcion: Wooden barrels marked with an oil-drop symbol catch fire and explode.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 to smother the flames without rupturing the barrels

flawed-ritual.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
flawed-ritual.descripcion: A flawed ritual emits surges of shadowy energy and opens tiny breaches into the Shadow Plane.

datos.desactivar:
Seven flaws have appeared in the ritual circle, dancing like shadowy flames. Each of Tavvar's three aides keeps one flaw under control as long as they are alive, while Tavvar herself staves off the ritual's implosion as listed in the ritual anchor ability below.

Each flaw can be repaired with a successful Occultism DC 22 or DC 18 (trained) check using a skill related to the flaw's original cause (see the table below). Regardless of success or failure, a PC who attempts an Occultism check to disable the hazard learns the cause of the flaws and the skills that can be used to overcome it.

Each success on a check to repair a flaw using these other skills reduces the DC of the Occultism check to repair a flaw by 2. Instead of using skill checks, the PCs can use force to stabilize the ritual. A PC who defeats a shadow wisp automatically repairs one flaw.

d4
Cause of Flaw
Skills to Overcome

1
Harried (a "publish or perish" culture at the College of Mystery led to Tavvar cutting corners in the ritual's execution, so some runes aren't drawn quite right)
Arcana DC 18 (trained) or Thievery DC 18 (trained)

2
Misplaced Affection (Tavvar is from Nidal and subconsciously hopes the ritual will show that there is some good in her homeland; she included some Shadowtongue in the runes and it's enhancing the energy
Society DC 18 (trained) or Religion DC 18 (trained)

3
Cloistered (Tavvar hasn't done much field work and made a dangerous mistake in which mushrooms she used in the ink for the runes)
Crafting DC 18 (trained) or Nature DC 18 (trained)

4
Restrained (Tavvar's own hesitation and self-doubt has led to the ritual slipping out of her control)
Deception DC 18 (trained) or Diplomacy DC 18 (trained)
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On each of its turns, the ritual lets out a surge of shadowy energy, dealing 2d6 void damage (basic Fortitude DC 18 save) to each character who participated in ritual the past round (including Tavvar and her aides as well as any PC who attempted a skill check to disable the hazard). A non-participant can step in front of a participant as a reaction. This blocks the damage from the ritual caster, but the non-participant must then attempt the Fortitude save.
In addition to dealing damage, the ritual's surge of energy brings a Shadow Wisp into the room. Wisps act at the end of the ritual's turn. If there are already two shadow wisps in the room, instead of creating a new wisp, the ritual restores 10 healing Hit Points to each wisp.

flooding-monolith-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-14: Lost in Flames
flooding-monolith-3-4.descripcion: A surge of abyssal energy creates a powerful wave pushing away from the monolith.

datos.desactivar:
Arcana DC 18, Occultism DC 18, or Religion DC 18 to magically alter the runes, or Thievery DC 21 to physically alter them. A PC that can read Abyssal or Cyclops is better able to identify key runes, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to these check (+2 if they speak both).

Each check requires two actions, and disabling the monolith requires three successful checks. A PC that critically succeeds earns two success. On a failed check, the attempting PC is exposed to the burning flames wreathing the monolith, taking 2d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 18 save).
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On the hazard's turn it sends a wave of water along the fork of the river (North, South, or East) that contains the nearest PC. Any creature along that fork in or on the surface of the water must attempt a Fortitude DC 18 save.

The monolith's guardians are accustomed to these surges and are immune to this effect.

—

Critical Success The creature takes advantage of the undertow after the surge to reposition themselves. The creature can Step, ignoring difficult terrain caused by the water.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is pushed 10 feet away from the monolith.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 15 feet away from the monolith and knocked Prone.

food-fight.descripcion: Ghostly food appears on cracked plates as they float above the table. The faint outline of children can occasionally be seen as the ectoplasmic food is flung throughout the room.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 17 (trained) to weaken the spiritual energy in the room, Acrobatics DC 18 (trained) to pluck a floating plate out of the air, or Intimidation DC 19 (trained) to reprimand one of the ghostly children for their poor behavior; each successful check disables one of four plates
datos.rutina: (4 actions) For each plate disabled or destroyed, the haunt has 1 fewer action. On each action, spectral food is flung off a plate at a different living creature in the room. This ranged Strike doesn't provoke reactions. A creature critically hit by a flung food Strike is also Dazzled for 1 round.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the room or after all four plates are destroyed. After 1 hour, if at least one plate remains, the haunt reactivates. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day and the plates magically reassemble. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area D5 is destroyed.

greased-floor-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades
greased-floor-3-4.descripcion: The floor is highly waxed and slippery.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 16 or Thievery DC 16 to remove the slippery coating or any ability that turns the area into difficult terrain.
datos.reinicio: Manual, reapply the wax.

handheld-quaker.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
handheld-quaker.descripcion: This small toy-like device has a hidden mechanism meant to be activated by the user, but the centuries have eroded its magical-mechanical components to the point that they activate at the slightest touch.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to deactivate the mechanism; Crafting DC 16 (trained) to identify and repair the problem components; two successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina:
At its initiative, to determine what the quaker does, roll  and consult the following table:
1: No action
2: A small quake: the terrain in a 10-foot emanation centered on the quaker shakes briefly. A creature in an affected square is knocked Prone (Reflex DC 18 save).
3: A medium quake: the terrain within the vault shakes constantly, transforming it into difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is knocked prone and takes 1d10 bludgeoning damage from the fall (basic Reflex DC 18 save).
4: A great quake: the terrain within the vault moves in waves, transforming it into greater difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is violently slammed to the ground, knocked prone, and takes 1d10+4 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 20 save).
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without a creature being within 5' of the handheld quaker.

haunting-echoes.descripcion: The spirits of community members linger on after their tragic deaths.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 20 (untrained) to Request that the spirits leave or Religion DC 18 (trained) to exorcise the spirits
datos.rutina:
(1 action; auditory, emotion, fear, mental) The haunt attempts an Intimidation check with a {+11} modifier against the Will DC of each Frightened creature as it bombards them with the voices of their dead loved ones.

—
Critical Success The creature takes 2d4 mental damage and its frightened condition increases by 1, to a maximum of Frightened 3.
Success The creature takes 1d4 mental damage.
Failure The creature is unaffected.
Critical Failure The creature's frightened condition is reduced by 1.
datos.reinicio: The haunt falls silent for 24 hours once all frightened creatures die or reduce their frightened condition's value to 0. During this time, a creature that isn't frightened can exorcise the spirits with a Religion DC 18 check, permanently destroying the haunt.

hidden-forest-bog.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-99: Blessings of the Forest
hidden-forest-bog.descripcion: A 15-foot wide area of verdant-covered water attempts to suck creatures down into it.

datos.desactivar: Two Survival DC 18 (trained) checks to find roots and tree limbs sturdy enough for everyone to use as escape paths ends the hazard's threat to all creatures in the area
datos.rutina:
(one action) On its initiative, the bog pulls down each creature within it. A creature that was submerged to its waist becomes submerged to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature partially or fully submerged in the bog can attempt a Athletics DC 16 check to Swim to either raise itself by one step (pulled under to submerged to its neck, or submerged to its neck to submerged to its waist), or to escape from the bog if it's submerged only up to its waist. This DC increases to Athletics DC 18 for creatures submerged up to their neck or worse. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step. Other creatures can Aid, typically by using a rope or similar assistance (providing an automatic success), or attempt to pull a single affected creature out with their own Athletics check, with the same results as if the aiding creature attempted the check itself.
datos.reinicio: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it accumulates leaf and greenery cover over the course of 24 hours.

hidden-spiked-pit.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: A Few Flowers More
hidden-spiked-pit.descripcion: A wooden trapdoor covers a pit that's 10 feet square and 20 feet deep. Knives are arrayed at the bottom of the trap, impaling anyone who falls on them.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to remove the trapdoor
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become Hidden again.

history-s-repetition-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
history-s-repetition-1-2.descripcion: Pebbles form into a hand the size of an ox, which reaches to crush anyone in the water.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to pick apart the pebbles, or Warfare-lore DC 15 to recognize and recreate the battle
datos.reinicio: 24 hours

hostile-architecture-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
hostile-architecture-1-2.descripcion: The sigils on the door's frame glow with an amber light, which collects in a facet over the center of the door.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 14 (trained) to strategically destroy the runes, Thievery DC 15 to disrupt the beam from collecting the facet, or Dispel Magic (1st rank, counteract DC 15) to dispel the rune
datos.rutina: a The hostile architecture fires its aversion beam on a creature that is sanctified holy. If there are no sanctified holy creatures, it instead fires its beam on the nearest non-demon creature.
datos.reinicio: The hostile architecture resets after being exposed to the light of a blue moon.

lights-out.descripcion: Patches of darkness envelop the rickety beds in this room, from which can be heard the sounds of gentle snoring from children.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 18 (trained) to ward off the darkness or Deception DC 19 or Performance DC 19 (trained) to pretend to be asleep; two total success are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action; darkness, occult) The haunt randomly chooses 1 living creature that it hadn't engulfed in darkness the previous round. Supernatural darkness wells over that creature, who must attempt a Will DC 18 save. On a failure, that creature is engulfed in a 5-foot emanation of darkness centered on them and is Blinded for 1 round. Any creatures in the emanation must attempt their own Will save or become blinded as well. Any non-magical light sources and magical light of 1st rank or lower the primary creature is holding or wearing cease to give off light for that duration.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the room but resets immediately thereafter. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer here is destroyed.

lodestone-trap.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
lodestone-trap.descripcion: The magical lodestone discharges bolts of electricity that also magnetize metal in the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 to unhook the pressure plates from the trap, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank, counteract DC 18) to counteract the trap
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the trap exerts a strong magnetic pull on the doors, causing the north and west doors to open if they're closed, or causing the south and east doors to close if they're open. A character can open or close a door against this pull with a successful Athletics DC 18 check to Force Open the door. At the same time, any character in the room who wears primarily metal armor must attempt a Reflex DC 18 save (characters in medium metal armor suffer a -1 circumstance penalty to this save, and characters in heavy metal armor suffer a -2 circumstance penalty).

—
Critical Success The PC is unaffected.
Success The PC resists the pull but treats the room as difficult terrain.
Failure The PC treats the room as difficult terrain and is knocked Prone. A PC who's already prone suffers a critical failure instead.
Critical Failure As failure, but the PC is also pulled 5 feet toward the lodestone. A PC who is adjacent to the lodestone instead becomes stuck to it and is Restrained as long as the trap continues its routine ().
datos.reinicio: At the end of a round in which there are no creatures standing on the floor or stuck to the lodestone, the trap deactivates. The vargouilles return to their alcoves, and the doors close. The trap resets automatically after 1 minute.

manipulator-s-metronome-1-2.descripcion: The hypnotic ticking of this metronome captures the attention of all who approach it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 or Crafting DC 15 to interfere with the metronome's mechanisms, Athletics DC 18 to grip the hand and prevent it from moving, or Arcana DC 18 or Occultism DC 18 to interpret the magic runes on the metronome and counteract its effects. Three successful checks are required to fully disable the metronome, ending its ticking.

mechanical-jaws-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-13: A Gilded Test
mechanical-jaws-3-4.descripcion: Mechanical jaws bolted to the stone beneath a camouflaged floor tile.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 16 (trained) on the jaw mechanism.

mushroom-ring-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-00: The King in Thorns
mushroom-ring-1-2.descripcion: This mushroom ring forms a portal to the First World, allowing the Thorned Monarch's reinforcements into the Material Plane. When the PCs approach, a creature emerges. Creatures continue to emerge until the mushroom ring is disabled. Disabling the mushroom ring also causes any creatures that have emerged to disappear.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 (trained) or Nature DC 18 to rearrange the mushrooms to disrupt the portal (two actions); three successes are required to disable the portal
datos.rutina: (1 action) A Pugwampi emerges from the mushroom ring and defends it. All pugwampis use the mushroom ring's initiative.

obscured-pitfalls.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
obscured-pitfalls.descripcion: A layer of disembodied eyes obscures a pitfall in the floor that's either deep enough for a human to fall into, or narrow enough to cause a painful fall.

datos.desactivar: This hazard can't be disabled, merely avoided.

offended-epitaphs.descripcion: Funerary inscriptions flicker and display different messages, causing ghostly ancestors to briefly appear and complain that their descendants have forgotten them.

datos.desactivar: three Diplomacy DC 20, Occultism DC 20, or Religion DC 20 checks to rebuke the cantankerous spirits
datos.rutina: (2 actions) Ancestral spirits appear throughout areas D1 and D2, each fading after several rounds to be replaced by a different spirit.

ostovite-nest.descripcion: A nest of bones resembling an ant hill contains countless miniscule scavenger vermin with vicious, acid-dripping mandibles.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 18 (trained) to topple the mound and destroy it
datos.rutina: (1 action) The hazard makes an acid spew Strike against the nearest creature.
datos.reinicio: The hazard deactivates if there are no targets for its acid spew at the start of its turn. The hatchlings return to the nest, and the hazard resets. If damaged but not destroyed, the nest recovers 1d6 healing Hit Points per hour as the hatchlings repair it.

pernicious-powder-keg.descripcion: A menacing clockwork contraption emerges from this impressively large and heavy-duty oaken barrel. A spring-loaded launcher mechanism catapults explosive-laden rats, and nozzles spray flammable oil before igniting it.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 18 or Thievery DC 18 check to jam the mechanism of one of the spray nozzles. Every success disables one of the three oil nozzles, reducing the hazards number of actions by 1. After all three of the oil nozzles are disabled, there is no longer any oil surrounding the barrel for the ignition mechanism to burn, so the hazard can't deal damage. The ignition mechanism can be disabled with another Crafting DC 18 or Thievery DC 18 check. Each attempt to disable the hazard requires 2 actions.
datos.rutina: Routine (4 actions) Three nozzles located around the device spew oil, which coats objects and floats on water. As the nozzles fluctuate in pressure, they cover everything nearby in oil, then ignite the oil with built-in spark lighters. The hazard's first action spreads oil out to 5 feet, the second action spreads it out to 10 feet, and the third spreads it out to 20 feet. Creatures in the area can attempt a Reflex DC 22 save to avoid being covered in oil. Once the oil has spread, the spark plug activates.

phantom-mold.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
phantom-mold.descripcion: A burst of pale gray spores sprays into the air.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 18 to remove the mold without triggering the spores

phoenix-rune-3-4.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot square surrounds an invisible rune on the wall or floor.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 18 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 18 (trained) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (1st rank, counteract DC 18) to counteract the rune.
datos.reinicio: Like its namesake creature, a phoenix rune is difficult to destroy. After it is triggered, a phoenix rune can immediately reset on a wall or floor within 120 feet, as long as it has not been disabled. When this happens, a PC who succeeds at a Perception DC 16 check spots the shadowy form of a tiny phoenix "flying" along the wall or floor from the rune's old location to its new location.

pile-of-fireworks-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #5: The Dragon who Stole Evoking Day

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 18 (trained), Engineering-lore DC 16 (trained), or Explosives-lore DC 16 (trained) to safely remove the lit firework or Thievery DC 18 (trained) to remove the lit fuse from the firework.

pit-of-lives-lost-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #15: In the Footsteps of Horror
pit-of-lives-lost-1-2.descripcion: The spout trickling blood, sludge, and offal begins to draw upon your life energy, increasing the flow and spreading an even fouler smell within the chamber.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 17 or Religion DC 17 (trained) to counteract the fell energies drawing in life force to power this strange charnel flow or Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disable the spout, stopping the flow at its source.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

pit-of-toil.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
pit-of-toil.descripcion: As ghostly, ectoplasm-dripping figures of dwarves work all around, the body of a living creature within the pit begins to ache with the pains of countless hours of back-breaking toil.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 21 (expert) to shame the pit by miming skilled artistry, or Religion DC 18 (trained) to exorcise the haunt.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; divine, necromancy) As the dwarves continue to chant and grasp at the living, the pit infuses all living creatures inside it with the ache and pain a body endures after hours of constant toil. Each living creature in the pit must attempt a Fortitude DC 18 save.

—
Critical Success The creature suffers no ill effect and is thereafter immune to the pit of toil's routine.
Success The creature suffers no ill effect.
Failure The creature takes 2d6 void damage and becomes Enfeebled 1 for 1 round.
Critical Failure The creature takes 4d6 void damage and becomes Fatigued.

pouncing-tiger-haunt.descripcion: A cave painting of a great cat roars to life and leaps off the wall to attack.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 18 (trained) or Religion DC 18 (trained) to quell the spirit
datos.reinicio: If the cave painting isn't destroyed, the haunt resets after 1 day.

precarious-pile.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Little Trouble in Big Absalom
precarious-pile.descripcion: This dangerously unsteady pile of miscellaneous goods stands 7 feet high and 10 feet wide

datos.desactivar:
Thievery DC 15 to carefully excavate a path through the wall without upsetting its balance

Athletics DC 17 to hold up any unstable portions

rain-soaked-crowd.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-04: An Enkindled Carnival
rain-soaked-crowd.descripcion: A crowd of carnival goers are spurred to panic by supernatural rain.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 17 (trained) to calm them down, Intimidation DC 18 (trained) to cow them, Athletics DC 20 (trained) to force them back

relive-the-rending-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-19: Enter the Pallid Peak
relive-the-rending-1-2.descripcion: The room shakes violently, as it did during the Rending, and the spirits of dozens of dwarves make a mad dash for safety, their terror palpable.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 18, Intimidation DC 18, or Religion DC 18 to calm the panicked spirits, or Athletics DC 20 to wrestle them into a semblance of order. Two successful checks are required to deactivate the haunt, and each attempt requires two actions.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Phantom dwarves trample toward the exit, dealing 1d10+4 bludgeoning damage to each living creature in the area (basic Reflex DC 20 save). On a critical failure, a creature is also knocked Prone.

A creature that attempts to Stand after being inside the haunt's area must succeed at a Flat DC 11 check or else get knocked back down by the trampling spirits.
datos.reinicio: Unless deactivated, the haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter. If deactivated, the haunt resets after 24 hours.

reservoir-trap.descripcion: Pipes extending from a pressurized water tank spray flesh-cutting jets of water at unwary passersby.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to safely puncture a pipe, or Engineering Lore (trained) to find and turn a pressure release valve; any combination of three punctured pipes or turned valves disables the trap
datos.rutina: (3 actions) For each pipe destroyed or disabled, the trap loses 1 action. On each of the trap's actions, the trap targets a random creature in the room with a water jet Strike.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates after 5 rounds. It cannot be reactivated until the reservoir is refilled, which takes an average of 5 days.

rushing-wind.descripcion: A raging wind sucks creatures in the area toward the aiudara.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 20 (trained) or Thievery DC 20 (trained) to recognize what's happening and craft a patch to block air from escaping through the portal
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The hazard uses its action to suck each creature (except the cairn wight) toward the aiudara. Each affected creature must attempt a Fortitude DC 18 save.
Success The creature is unaffected.
Failure The creature is pulled 5 feet toward the aiudara and is Stunned 1. If the creature is already adjacent to the aiudara, it doesn't move but is Stunned 2.
Critical Failure The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the aiudara, falls Prone, and is stunned 1. If the creature is already adjacent to the aiudara, it doesn't move but falls prone and is stunned 2.

rusted-door.descripcion: Shards of rust extend from the door and crumble away to cling to the flesh and clothes of anyone who attempts to open or damage the door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 to deface the hidden runes that allow the trap to activate, or Religion DC 21 to offer prayers to a non-evil deity to override the ancient influence of Xar-Azmak
datos.reinicio: The rusted door resets automatically after 1 round.

rusty-floor-spikes.descripcion: Pressure plates on the floor near the north door cause rusty spikes to lance up out of the floor in area C3.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to disable the pressure plates.
datos.reinicio: Turn the resetting wheel in the eastern Inner Guard Station (area C8b).

scrabbling-hands.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
scrabbling-hands.descripcion: Illusory hands tear from the floorboards, clawing at their victim's legs and leaving real wounds.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 16 (trained) to exorcize the spirits
datos.reinicio: The underlying spirits remain, resetting the haunt every midnight, until the true story of what happened here becomes public.

shadow-guards.descripcion: Shadowy caricatures of elves peel themselves from the floor and attack everyone in the room.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 16 to move through the room without touching any of the runes, followed by Thievery DC 18 (trained) to carve them out of the wood without triggering them; or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the runes
datos.rutina: (1 action) The drawings stab at each character in the room with spears drawn from sharp lines.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute. The drawings cannot pursue characters out of the room.

shard-s-fury.descripcion: Wisps of red energy and violent urges emanate from the crater.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 18 to overpower the warshard's will, Religion DC 18 to calm the belligerent miasma
datos.reinicio: The residual energies reset after 1 hour.

shrinking-hall.descripcion: This hallway is designed to shrink as creatures traverse it, making access to the door at the hall's end impossible.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (trained) to jam the scales built into the floor
datos.reinicio: After 10 minutes without weight being placed on this hall's floor, this trap resets, returning the hall to its original size.

smoke-filled-hallway.descripcion: Thick smoke fills this hallway, making it difficult to see and breathe.

datos.desactivar: While a spell like Gust of Wind can temporarily clear a path through the smoke, the hazard returns at the start of the next round as long as the fires in area A17 continue to burn; Survival DC 18 to know how best to cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth to help alleviate the choking effects of the smoke.
datos.reinicio: The smoke continues to affect anyone who enters area A16 until the fires in area A17 are extinguished.

smoke-filled-room.descripcion: Thick smoke fills this room, making it difficult to see and breathe.

datos.desactivar: While a spell like Gust of Wind can temporarily clear a path through the smoke, the hazard returns at the start of the next round as long as the fires in area A17 continue to burn; Survival DC 18 to know how best to cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth to help alleviate the choking effects of the smoke.
datos.reinicio: The smoke continues to affect anyone who enters area A16 until the fires in area A17 are extinguished.

snakebush-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-13: Within the Prairies
snakebush-3-4.descripcion: The branches of this peculiar bush are heavy with ripening berries.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 18 (trained) to avoid gathering unripe berries

spear-launcher.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: The Fall of Plaguestone
spear-launcher.descripcion: An old heavy crossbow is hidden in a pile of trash, loaded with a wooden spear, and connected to the rope holding the door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery (trained) on the rope allows a PC to tie the rope off and open the door without setting off the trap.

spear-launcher-bb.fuente: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star
spear-launcher-bb.descripcion: A wall socket loaded with a spear connects to a floor tile in one 5-foot square.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 on the floor tile or wall socket.

spear-launcher-q9-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales
spear-launcher-q9-1-2.descripcion: A wall socket loaded with a spear connects to a floor tile in one 5-foot square.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) on the floor tile or wall socket

spear-launcher-troubles-in-grayce.descripcion: A wall socket loaded with a spear connects to a floor tile in one 5-foot square.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) on the floor tile or wall socket
datos.reinicio: The launchers require manual reload.

spicebomb-3-4.descripcion: Several spice bombs disguised as rocks litter the ground.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 to remove the bombs without activating them or Survival DC 16 (trained) to render them inert.

spike-thrower.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
spike-thrower.descripcion: Slats in the ceiling open and pepper the chamber below with long, metal spikes fired from the spring-loaded tubes.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 to jam the gears and prevent the trap from being activated

spiked-pit.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
spiked-pit.descripcion: A wooden trapdoor covers a pit that's 10 feet square and 20 feet deep. Sharp spikes line the bottom of the pit.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 14 to remove the trapdoor
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

spitter-pods.descripcion: Specialized spore pods burst open, expel toxic globules, and recharge from alchemical reservoirs.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 18 to add disruptive chemicals to the fungus's reservoir, Nature DC 18 (trained) to recognize how to constrict the chemicals' flow, or Deception DC 20 (trained) to spread spores that befuddle the fungus; three total successes are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The spitter pods alternate between making Strikes and Reloading. The pods lose 1 action for each successful check to disable the trap.

spitting-hot-candy-pot.descripcion: A massive bronze cauldron of molten candy bubbles on the stove, spraying sticky-sweet hot caramel in all directions.

datos.desactivar: Breaking the pot disables it as soon as its rupture reaction is resolved.
datos.rutina:
(2 actions) On each of the pot's actions, it targets one creature hostile against Larmine within 30 feet of the pot, spitting a glob of hot molten candy that deals 1d8+4 fire damage; the target creature must attempt a Reflex DC 16 save.

—
Critical Success The target is unaffected.
Success The target takes half damage.
Failure The target takes full damage and is Slowed 1 as the sticky molten candy glues them to the floor.
Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is Slowed 2, and takes 1d4 persistent damage as the hot candy sticks to their exposed skin.

stonescale-spirits.descripcion: A half-dozen ghostly kobolds rise from the rubble in a howling vortex.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 18 (trained) to frighten the spirits with a threatening display, or Religion DC 21 (trained) to exorcise the spirits
datos.rutina: (1 action) The spirits swoop together toward one creature in area A7 who's Frightened, instilling feelings of betrayal and confusion. The target takes 1d10+4 mental damage (basic Will DC 18 save).
datos.reinicio:
The haunt deactivates if there are no frightened creatures in area A7 at the start of its turn. The ghostly kobolds return to the rubble pile.

The haunt can't activate again for 1 hour.

suncatcher-blooms-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-13: Within the Prairies
suncatcher-blooms-1-2.descripcion: Bright, iridescent blue petals sprout from the cerulean center of this flower.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 18 (trained) to safely move through the flowers without activating the pollen.

swampy-quicksand.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #1: The Second Confirmation
swampy-quicksand.descripcion: A 15-foot-wide patch of water and sand attempts to submerge creatures that step onto it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 16 (trained) to disturb the surface
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the quicksand pulls down each creature within it. A creature that was submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and has to hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature in the quicksand can attempt a Athletics DC 18 check to Swim to either raise itself by one step if it's submerged to its neck or worse, or to move 5 feet if it's submerged only up to its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step. A creature that Swims out of the quicksand escapes the hazard and is prone in a space adjacent to the quicksand patch. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar aid, or attempt to pull the creature out with their own Athletics DC 18 check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check.
datos.reinicio: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 24 hours.

talhindir-s-fall.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
talhindir-s-fall.descripcion: All lights in the room snap on, just as Lyari remembers the day of her death. A susurrus of accusations and a guilty verdict fill the air. Ghostly elven warriors disappear and reappear in a disorienting and implacable advance.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 20 to stand against the force of the verdict, or Arcana DC 20, Occultism DC 20, or Religion DC 20 to ritually disrupt the haunting. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled and the Hunted by Chains haunt triggers.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The haunt makes vengeful judgment Strikes against three different random creatures trapped in this haunt. A spectral pool of blood forms beneath any creature knocked Unconscious by this haunt.
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets the next time the Soulshackle traps creatures in the library.

toppling-furniture.descripcion: A mischievous spirit pushes a bookshelf over onto a creature.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 16 to hold the furniture upright or Occultism DC 18 (trained) to foil the spirit's efforts to influence matter
datos.reinicio: If the haunt successfully damages a creature with Topple Furniture, the spirit laughs for {1d4 rounds} as the haunt resets; each subsequent time the haunt activates, it must topple a different piece of upright furniture. If the haunt fails to damage a creature, the spirit wails in frustration and resets after pouting for {1d4 hours}.

trapped-elevator.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
trapped-elevator.descripcion: An oversized cauldron rigged as an elevator suddenly drops 30 feet if it's overloaded.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to lock the releasing mechanisms in place, or Crafting DC 20 to rig additional supports for the cauldron (this activity requires 10 minutes of work)
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall down the shaft even after the cauldron is released, but the cauldron must be reset manually.

twisted-fountain.descripcion: Water pours from this carved dwarf's mouth and has a sharp, rusty flavor.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 16 (trained) to plug up the mouth and cause the fountain to deactivate as long as it remains plugged, Religion DC 21 (expert) to pray to gods opposed to Droskar to exorcise the magic and permanently halt the water flow, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 16) to suppress the trap's tainted taste effect for 10 minutes
datos.reinicio: The twisted fountain resets instantly.

unbridled-necromantic-energy-1-2.descripcion: Magical energy contained within the room surges in flashes of dark lightning.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 17 (trained) to restore some of the arcane wards, Religion DC 20 or Occultism DC 20 (trained) to quell the necromantic energy in the room.
datos.reinicio: 10 minutes

unbridled-necromantic-energy-3-4.descripcion: Magical energy contained within the room surges in flashes of dark lightning.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 20 (trained) to restore some of the arcane wards, Religion DC 23 or Occultism DC 23 (trained) to quell the necromantic energy in the room.
datos.reinicio: 10 minutes

unstable-column-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
unstable-column-3-4.descripcion: Plaster crumbles from this column moments before it collapses.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 18 (trained) to stabilize the column, Athletics DC 21 to push the column back into place

unstable-furniture-archway.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
unstable-furniture-archway.descripcion: This unsteady pile of furniture is piled to the top of this usually high-ceilinged room. There looks to be some space to squeeze through to the other side, but even the slightest touch causes the stack to destabilize, and there's so much that once it begins to fall, it's difficult to stop.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 21 to knock the pile over in a safe direction or Thievery DC 19 (trained) to carefully rearrange the furniture to a stable configuration.
datos.rutina: On its initiative, the pile expands into an adjacent space, dealing creatures in that space 1d6+4 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex DC 18 save, pushing any creatures in that space into an adjacent empty space, and making that space impassable until cleared. If no adjacent empty space is available, the pile buries the creature, suffocating it. Clearing a space or pulling a creature out requires a Athletics DC 15 check.

violet-mister.descripcion: Opening the door pulls a thread, which causes a plant mister to spray a cloud of poison into the triggering creature's face.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 to safely cut the thread

volatile-reagents.fuente: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
volatile-reagents.descripcion: Potion bottles, alembics, and potent ingredients violently explode when jostled and accidentally combined.

datos.desactivar: Three Acrobatics DC 20 or Crafting DC 20 checks to sort and separate the bottles of volatile ingredients into groups
datos.rutina: (1 action) A random 10-foot square in Gattlebee's laboratory explodes, dealing 2d6 damage to creatures and objects in the area (basic Reflex DC 18). The damage type is randomly determined each round: acid, cold, electricity, fire, slashing, or sonic.
datos.reinicio: The lab contains enough ingredients for this hazard to last 1 minute before all materials are expended. Alternatively, the hazard resets once Slick shrinks to regular size.

warp-pillar.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-16: A Star's Journey
warp-pillar.descripcion: A time-disrupting field shimmers around a 9-foot-tall pillar of obsidian and bronze that magically slides across the room.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 18, Crafting DC 18, Occultism DC 18, or Thievery DC 18; three successes deactivates a pillar, as does destroying it.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The pillar Steps or Strides to get as close to as many targets as possible, then makes a time drain Strike against each creature within its reach.
datos.reinicio: If the pillar isn't destroyed, it resets 1 minute after making no time drain attacks.

web-lurker-noose.descripcion: Discreet webbing at throat level snags a creature that walks into it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 18 (trained) or Thievery DC 18 (expert) to rearrange the webbing

web-noose.descripcion: A looped length of webbing snags a creature that walks into it and yanks them painfully off the ground.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 19 (trained) or Thievery DC 19 (expert) to rearrange the webbing

whispering-spirits.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
whispering-spirits.descripcion: Lost spirits whisper, reliving their last moments, ready to drag the living into their illusion.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 16 (trained) to suppress the spirits or Performance DC 16 (trained) to drown them out
datos.reinicio: The underlying spirits remain, resetting the haunt every midnight, until what truly happened here becomes public.

abendego-s-squall-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
abendego-s-squall-1-2.descripcion: A massive orca known as Abendego's Squall leaps from the water. Its mouth opens to snap against any part of the ship that it can reach.

datos.desactivar: Medicine DC 20 (trained) to remove the harpoon, Nature DC 17 (trained) to calm the orca, or Intimidation DC 20 (trained) to scare the orca away; two total successes are required to subdue the orca
datos.rutina:
d Abendego's Squall Leaps over the Snapdragon with each action. When it lands, it deals 1 damage to the Snapdragon. All creatures on the deck take 1d8 bludgeoning damage and must attempt a Reflex DC 20 save.

—
Critical Success The target is unaffected.
Success The target takes half damage.
Failure The target takes full damage and is Clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.
Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is Clumsy 2 until the end of its next turn.

—
Speed 30 feet
datos.reinicio: The orca returns to hunt down the Snapdragon after 8 hours.

acid-spray-trap.descripcion: Hidden nozzles in the ceiling spray acid pumped in from a nearby reservoir to destroy the desk and all its documents, as well as anyone trying to retrieve those documents.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disable one of the two acid-spewing nozzles or Crafting DC 21 (trained) to rig a makeshift plug for one of the two nozzles
datos.rutina: (1 action) The nozzles spray acid from the ceiling onto every creature adjacent to the desk. Each affected creature takes 4d6 acid damage (basic Reflex DC 20 save). For each broken nozzle, this damage is reduced by 2d6.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates after 1 minute. To be reset, the trap's reserve tanks must be refilled with acid.

aeon-nexus-3-4.descripcion: A small cluster of aeon stones floats two feet off the ground, orbiting by shards of shattered aeon stones that crackle with electricity.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) to remove one nexus aeon stone from the center
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap loses one action each turn for each nexus aeon stone removed from its center. On each action, it shoots a jet of electrified, razor-sharp aeon stone shards at a different creature within 30 feet, dealing 1d8 piercing damage and 1d8 electricity damage (basic Reflex DC 21).

alarmingly-efficient-unseen-arson-assist.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-16: Dacilane Academy's First Great Prank War
alarmingly-efficient-unseen-arson-assist.descripcion: Fire engulfs four 5-foot-by-5-foot sections of the library, then spreads erratically on each of its turns as burning books are carried about by the modified unseen servant.

datos.desactivar: A successful Athletics DC 18, Nature DC 18, or Survival DC 18 check from an adjacent square is sufficient to smother one 5-foot- square of fire; each attempt is an Interact action. Dousing the flames automatically extinguishes one or more sections of fire, with no check. Water typically clears a 5-foot square if the amount is small (such as that from Create Water or Hydraulic Push). Larger amounts of water, such as a full bucket, typically douse a 10-foot-by-10-foot area (or 4 squares in some other shape). Throwing a bucket of water on flames requires an Interact action. A waterskin doesn't contain enough water to put out even 1 square of fire. Cold can also put out fire, but only if the cold can affect an area; cold is usually less effective than water, so a Frost Vial typically puts out only 1 square of fire, and ray of frost is ineffective.
datos.rutina: On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies plus the number of books that the lurkers in light lit on fire this round, minimum 1 square. You determine the squares the fire spreads into, but any spread from lit books must affect a bookshelf; fires spread in this way do not need to spread into adjacent squares. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes 1d6 fire damage, and any creature within the flames takes 4d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 18 save for both). A creature can take damage from flames only once per round.

apple-turnover.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-03: Godsrain in a Godless Land
apple-turnover.descripcion: A fruit merchant's cart has been poorly secured. The slightest careless bump on the way past is enough to knock it over and topple the fruit it carries all over the street.

datos.desactivar: If all the PCs succeed on a Perception check against the Stealth DC to spot the hazard, they're able to pass by that cart without triggering it. There's not enough time for PCs who succeed on this check to warn PCs who fail.

arms-of-the-drowned.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
arms-of-the-drowned.descripcion: Ghostly arms rise up from the water to clutch and grab, while a geyser of leech-infested water sprays up into the central shrine.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 to offer prayers to calm the haunt, or Intimidation DC 23 to threaten the unquiet spirits away
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Ghostly arms flail about and attempt to grab creatures in the shrine or on either bridge. Each round, the haunt uses 3 actions to attempt to grapple a PC on the bridge or in the shrine. If a PC is Restrained, the haunt can use one of its actions to drag a PC into the river. A PC who's restrained in the river risks drowning.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates and resets at the start of any round in which the PCs aren't in the river, on the bridges, or in the shrines, but the leech swarms remain in the shrine for 10 minutes before retreating back into the water below.

augmented-azlanti-elemental-nexus.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-02: The Blackwood Lost
augmented-azlanti-elemental-nexus.descripcion: A large cylindrical metallic structure surrounded by dense cables and pipes, anointed with mystical runes which glow and hum vibrantly. Elemental energy arcs off three spikes that may have once been connected to some of the cables.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 20 (trained) to restart the machine's connection to an elemental plane, or Thievery DC 23 (trained) to find and deactivate the whichever rune is currently active; three total successes are required to disable the nexus. A spike can be disabled with a Athletics DC 23 (trained) check to rip it from the structure or a Crafting DC 20 (trained) check to reconnect some of the cables. If all 6 elemental energies are returned to the nexus, it is disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The nexus spends each of its actions making an elemental wave Strike; each of these must be against a different creature who does not have the elemental trait. For each spike destroyed or disabled, the trap loses 1 action.

bad-vibrations.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: A Fistful of Flowers
bad-vibrations.descripcion: The three larger crystals on the table begin to vibrate and emit a swiftly growing peal of sound.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) or Occultism DC 17 (trained) to disrupt the magic enchanting one of the crystals, or Performance DC 20 (trained) by a character who can cast Counter Performance to use sound to redirect the noise back into the crystal, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank, DC 18) to counteract a crystal.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The hazard loses 1 action for each crystal that's disabled or destroyed. On each of the trap's actions, one of the crystals fires a blast of sound at a single Small or larger creature in the room. The target is randomly determined and takes 1d8 sonic damage (basic Fortitude DC 20); a target who critically fails this save is Deafened for 1 minute. At the end of the hazard's routine, attempt a Flat DC 10. On a success, one of the crystals shatters and is destroyed.

balance-point.descripcion: A 40-foot deep pit is obscured by a false floor set over a single balance point. Pressure on either side to the east or west causes occupants to fall into the depths below.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to attach the balanced stone floor piece to the actual floor and lock it in place, or Crafting DC 23 (trained) to jury-rig a quick bit of extra support to prevent the floor from tilting

befuddled-thoughts.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
befuddled-thoughts.descripcion: The fanged skull rune begins speaking in sweet, honeyed tones about eternal life.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) to exorcise the spirit, Religion DC 21 or Occultism DC 21 (trained) to sever the connection between Hunger's Call and the temple, or Athletics DC 21 to crack the wall in several places; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) A pulsing red ball of energy flies from the wall and explodes in negative energy in the room. Anyone in the room takes 1d10+4 void damage (basic Reflex DC 20 save).
datos.reinicio: The mosaic ceases its routine 2 rounds after all living creatures are out of sight of the stairs. After 6 hours the haunt is ready to trigger again.

blessed-crossbow-trap.descripcion: A crossbow hidden by the shrine's back curtains is ready to shoot. The loaded bolt is magically augmented with holy power to strike true against demons.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disable the trigger wire.

blood-hunger.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
blood-hunger.descripcion: Blood flows from the fanged skull rune as if it were an open wound.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) to exorcise the spirit, Religion DC 21 or Occultism DC 21 (trained) to sever the connection between Hunger's Call and the temple, or Crafting DC 21 (trained) to break up the pattern of the mural; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The bloody mosaic blasts shards of colored glass at anyone within 10 feet of the eastern wall, and they each take 1d10 slashing damage plus 1 bleed damage (basic Reflex DC 20 save; critical success negates the bleed damage).
datos.reinicio: The mosaic ceases its routine 2 rounds after all living creatures are out of sight of the stairs. After 6 hours the haunt is ready to trigger again.

blood-of-belcorra.descripcion: A bloody image of Belcorra arises, emits a soul‑draining light, then inhales blood from living creatures in the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to wipe away enough of the bloodstain to disrupt the haunt's necromantic energies, or Religion DC 20 (trained) to exorcise the haunt
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The bloody image opens its mouth and appears to inhale, drawing blood from the body of one creature in its line of sight within 90 feet from the center of area A11. The creature targeted must attempt a Fortitude DC 20 save.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 1d10 bleed.

Failure The creature takes 1d10+6 bleed damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes 2d10+6 bleed damage and is Enfeebled 2 as long as it's bleeding.
datos.reinicio:
If the haunt is disabled or destroyed through damage, the bloody phantom of Belcorra sprays upward in a spiral, dousing the trap door leading to area A25 before draining upward through the keyhole, which reduces the Thievery DC to Pick the Lock to Thievery DC 20.

At the next sunrise, the blood drains back down to this room and the haunt resets. The haunt is destroyed permanently once Lasda Venkervale is rescued from area D9.

bloody-vortex-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-06: The Crashing Wave
bloody-vortex-5-6.descripcion: A bloody vortex violently draining into a crack of raw elemental energy, fueled by the curse of a sea devil oracle.

datos.desactivar: Slay Silaqui, or Thievery DC 20 (trained) to pry the gem out of Silaqui followed by disrupting the gem's power by either breaking it (AC 18, Hardness 10, HP 45, BT 23) or using Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 19)
datos.rutina:
All creatures within 40 feet of the vortex except Silaqui are drawn toward it. They must attempt either a Fortitude DC 17 save or an Athletics DC 17 check to Swim with a DC of 17, with the following results.

—

Success The creature is not moved.

Failure The creature is moved 10 feet closer to the center of the vortex. If this causes the creature to reach the center square of the vortex, they are exposed to Consuming Maelstrom.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is moved 20 feet closer to the center of the vortex.

boggard-pit-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-20: The Lost Legend
boggard-pit-5-6.descripcion: A net with soil and aquatic plants on it covers a 10-foot pit dug into the bottom of a body of water.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 to remove the net
datos.reinicio: Others can fall into the pit, but the net entangles only the first creature to trigger the trap. The net must be reset manually.

breeg-s-traps.descripcion:
Several dozen spike snares are littered across this hex.

—

Treasure: Each time a PC triggers a trap, the trap is destroyed. If all the traps are disabled, materials to craft six spike snares can be salvaged.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 17 (made as an individual hexploration activity) to locate and disarm all the traps by hand.
datos.reinicio: There are enough traps in this hex that this hazard can be triggered up to 5 times before all the traps are used up.

bubbling-pile-of-orts.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-01: Intro to the Year of Battle's Spark: Enough is Enough
bubbling-pile-of-orts.descripcion: A rift to Hell crackles with unstable energy from the broken summoning circle as a squirming mass of fiends struggles to emerge A blood mist projection of a Hellknight angrily commands them.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 19, Nature DC 19, Occultism DC 19, or Religion DC 19 (2 actions) (trained) while within 15 feet to weaken the rift, dealing 3d4 spirit damage to it. This damage has the holy trait.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The Hellknight commands the orts, and the trap lashes out at each enemy creature in its space and adjacent, dealing 1d10+6 slashing damage (basic Reflex DC 18 save) If no enemy is in reach, an ort emerges in an adjacent square.

buried-shock-glyph.descripcion: A magical glyph unleashes a blast of electricity when handled.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 20 (trained) to hurl the stone a safe distance before it activates, or Thievery DC 21 to delicately move the stone without triggering the glyph.

bursting-bone-vault.descripcion: This bone-filled vault disgorges its contents the moment the vault door slides open.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) or Stealth DC 20 (trained) to carefully open the vault door without disturbing the bones

butterfly-s-breath-trap-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-12: Negotiations for the Star Gun
butterfly-s-breath-trap-3-4.descripcion: A sickly-sweet perfume wafts through the air outside the council building, assaulting the senses of all that inhale it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 to hold your breath through the perfume, Occultism DC 19 (trained) to draw a warding rune in the air to disperse the poison, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 17) to counteract the poison

caustic-mud-pot.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-10: Delve the Pallid Depths
caustic-mud-pot.descripcion: Solid ground gives way to a lake of bubbling mud that burns anyone who enters and routinely belches out sulfur.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) to find and remove the stones blocking the flow of water to the mud pot. The water decreases the viscosity of the mud, allowing steam and sulfur to escape gradually, rather than in violent bursts, so creatures can pass through unharmed. The hazard requires one successful checks to disable. Attempting the check takes two actions.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the mud pot belches a cloud of sickening sulfur into the small cavern. Creatures other than sulfuric slimes within 10 feet must succeed at a Fortitude DC 17 save or be exposed to sulfur poisoning.

chaotic-door-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-09: The Seven Secrets of Dacilane Academy
chaotic-door-3-4.descripcion: The frame splinters as the door flings open, the force hitting those nearby.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 20 (trained) to hold the door shut against the force, or Thievery DC 21 (trained) to deftly relieve pressure from the door.

charge-of-the-spear-legion.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
charge-of-the-spear-legion.descripcion: When triggered, the room lurches suddenly on its side, causing those in the room to slide down toward the double line of spears on the west wall while the statues on the east slide down on a pulley-and-roller system to smash into the victims.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 to deactivate the triggering pressure plate near the northern door
datos.reinicio: After 1 minute, the chamber rights itself and resets the trap.

cheerful-tune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
cheerful-tune.descripcion: A cheerful, wordless tune fills the room, compelling everyone to get to work.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) to exorcise the spirits, or Intimidation DC 21 to convince the spirits it is time to take a break; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Ghostly workers appear in the room and begin abrading, scrubbing, and splashing cleaning chemicals on anyone in the area. Each creature in the room takes 1d4+2 slashing and 1d4+2 acid damage (basic Reflex DC 20 save; roll once for both).
datos.reinicio: The ghostly workers cease their routine 2 rounds after all living creatures leave the room and reset after 6 hours.

churning-lava-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-19: Enter the Pallid Peak
churning-lava-3-4.descripcion: The equilibrium of the brown mold and lava river is disturbed, creating bubbles of molten stone that burst and spew burning debris.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 17 or Survival DC 17 or Thievery DC 20 to clear your square and all adjacent squares of the mold; the churning lava does not target creatures in cleared squares with its spatter attack, but the hazard is not destroyed until every square has been cleared of mold.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On the its initiative, the churning lava targets a random creature in the area with a ranged spatter attack as a magma bubble bursts.
datos.reinicio: If not completely destroyed, the mold spreads to one additional square within 10 feet of lava each day until it fully regenerates and regains its state of equilibrium. If every square is cleaned of mold, the hazard is destroyed.

cleaning-agents.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
cleaning-agents.descripcion: Solvents and detergents spray from the ceiling and run down the walls where they combine in dangerous ways.
