datos.desactivar: Engineering Lore (trained) or Thievery DC 20 (trained) to deactivate the control panel, or Athletics DC 21 or Acrobatics DC 21 to plug the spouts that release the chemicals; three successes are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap fills the room with a cloud of caustic vapor and deals 2d6+2 acid damage to all creatures in the area (basic Fortitude DC 20).
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates after 1 minute and resets in 1 hour.

cloud-of-reverie.descripcion: A cloud of shimmering blue dust erupts from the chest and lingers in the air.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 or Medicine DC 23 to recognize the distinct aroma as belonging to incense of reverie and take necessary precautions when opening the chest, such as holding one's breath and shielding the face from exposure.

collapsing-barricade-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-11: Flames of Rebellion
collapsing-barricade-1-2.descripcion: A tunnel through this steep barricade is rigged to collapse. If a kobold spends one action to throw a lever, the tunnel collapses on the next creature to pass through.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to carefully trigger the collapse without entering the tunnel or Thievery DC 22 (trained) to brace the tunnel so it is safe to pass through.

collapsing-cabinet-3-4.descripcion:
Fluids from leaking beakers have eaten nearly through the supports holding up this cabinet.

This Broken Threshold for this trap is 10, not 20.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to gently place something under the cabinet to support its weight.

collapsing-ceiling-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave
collapsing-ceiling-3-4.descripcion: The damaged ceiling is the only thing stopping the centipedes lairing above from falling through.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 22 (trained) to reinforce the ceiling with boards from the broken door.

cooking-catastrophe.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-18: Dacilane Academy's Delightful Disaster
cooking-catastrophe.descripcion: Skillet sputter and pots threaten to boil over, splashing their contents onto careless cooks or kitchen counters. The counters are covered with small dishes ready to add, along with 3 heavy cookbooks and a healthy coating of flour.

datos.desactivar: Cooking-lore DC 17 (trained) or Crafting DC 20 to add the proper ingredients to finish the dish. Diplomacy DC 20 or Occultism DC 20 to communicate with students when to stir or adjust the heat on a dish. Each disable attempt requires two actions, and three successful checks are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap uses each of its actions to make a splatter attack against a random creature in the kitchen. The trap never targets a student, as they are out of phase with it. For every successful disable attempt on the trap, it loses an action.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates after 1 minute, destroying all of the food. If left untouched, it resets automatically in 24 hours.

cracked-earth.descripcion: This 20-foot-by-20-foot patch of ground is cobwebbed with cracks and fissures that crumble when a creature steps on it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 16 (untrained) to collapse safely; Crafting DC 20 (trained) to shore it up enough to pass over without collapsing it

crumbling-floor--pathfinder-society-scen.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers
crumbling-floor--pathfinder-society-scen.descripcion: At a cursory glance the tunnel appears to be little more than a waterlogged chamber.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 17 (trained) to safely navigate the wet floor without stepping on any loose masonry or Thievery DC 19 (expert) to cause a controlled collapse without any danger to the PCs.

cursed-digging-machine.descripcion: A large, wheeled cart with a multi-sectioned pole in the middle. Each section of pole has several shovels sticking out of it like makeshift arms.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) twice on the cart to dismantle core connected pieces, or Nature DC 20 or Occultism DC 20 (trained) check to temporarily disable the jinkins' curse and render the machine inert for an hour
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The digging machine spends an action to move 20 feet toward the nearest creature. If it starts next to a creature, it moves 20 feet toward the next closest creature. It then makes two slashing shovels attacks against any creature within 10 feet.

cursed-mural.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
cursed-mural.descripcion: The faint image of Shelyn performing for an enraptured audience distorts into a nightmare scene of a dead god tormenting the souls of her followers.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 (trained) to offer prayers to counteract the blasphemies or Performance DC 20 (expert) to give the tormented souls a more positive performance to enjoy; two successes are required to disable it.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The sounds of the undead Shelyn's performance grow audible, bringing a somber, menacing dirge to the shrine. As undead Shelyn plays, creatures depicted in the mural die horrific deaths and send blasts of tormented spiritual energy spiraling out into the shrine. The haunt uses its three actions to make lifedrain Strikes at three different sapient targets in area A22, sending a tormented, phantasmal, and gory remnant spiraling out from the mural each time. A creature can only be targeted by a lifedrain Strike once per round.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates at the end of the third consecutive round in which there are no living, sapient creatures in area A22, then resets automatically the next round.

damaged-jaws-of-hell.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-06: Brastlewark at War Part 1: The Gnome Defection
damaged-jaws-of-hell.descripcion: The machine is a cylindrical device ringed in blades with a devilish eye at its center. Gnome inventors created the mechanical device, which taps into the planes of earth and fre to create powerful blasts to damage fortress walls or decimate ranks of enemies. Unfortunately, the many miles of forest have not been kind and it's malfunctioning. The damaged jaws planar connections have weakened to a mere trickle and, when activated, it lashes out in an uncontrolled frenzy. The blades encircling it begin lashing out.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 18, Crafting DC 18, Nature DC 18, or Thievery DC 18 (trained) twice, to sever the connection to the planes of fre and earth. Crafting DC 16 or Thievery DC 16 (trained) once, to remove the pintle connecting the limber to the horses. A creature must be adjacent to the jaws to make either check.
datos.rutina: (three actions) On its turn each round, the horses spend one action to move 30 feet, dragging the limber carrying the jaws behind them in a randomly chosen direction. The horses will not move through other creatures. Players on the limber when it moves must attempt a Acrobatics DC 18 check when it moves or fall of. Removing the pintle will end the random movement. The jaws use 2 actions to Spit Fire or make melee strikes against an adjacent creature.
datos.reinicio: The planar connection shuts down after 1 minute. The horses will tire and stop running after 1 minute.

dangerous-collapsing-debris.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers
dangerous-collapsing-debris.descripcion: The room initially appears merely dilapidated, but on closer inspection it is positively liable to collapse at any moment.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 23 (untrained) to safely shore up the weaknesses in the masonry by replacing rotten wood with other assorted bric-a-brac, Thievery DC 20 (trained) to carefully place boards and the like to create bridges over structurally weak areas.

dart-barrage.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
dart-barrage.descripcion: Four dart-loaded pipes hidden in the diagonal walls are connected to a pressure plate under the brass seal in the room's center.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to disable the pressure plate, or four Thievery DC 18 (trained) checks to plug the dart launchers
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action for each disabled launcher. On each of the trap's actions, it fires one dart at a creature in the center of the room.
datos.reinicio: The trap runs out of darts after 4 rounds of firing and must be reset manually by dismantling the walls to reload the launchers. If at any point there are no longer more than two creatures placing weight on the floor, the trap ceases firing but remains armed, ready to resume firing its remaining darts once triggered again.

deadfall-trap-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-04: Bandits of Immenwood
deadfall-trap-3-4.descripcion: A large tree has been cut down and supported only by a rope.

datos.desactivar: The trap cannot be disabled in advance (unless the PCs are able to out stealth Vengeant Thorn and sneak up on him before the wagon reaches the target zone).

death-drop-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-04: To Seek the Heart of Calamity
death-drop-3-4.descripcion: An invisible force shoves creatures backwards, hurling them through the chamber's doorway.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 20 (trained) to disperse the force or Religion DC 18 (trained) to hide from the ominous presence's senses
datos.reinicio: 1 day

delicate-crumbling-floor.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers
delicate-crumbling-floor.descripcion: At a cursory glance the tunnel appears to be little more than a waterlogged chamber.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 20 (trained) to safely navigate the wet floor without stepping on any loose masonry or Thievery DC 22 (expert) to cause a controlled collapse without any danger to the PCs.

demon-ship.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
demon-ship.descripcion: A demonic presence animates the ship carrying demon pirates.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) to ward against demonic presence, Arcana DC 20 (trained) or Occultism DC 20 (trained) to weaken the demonic possession, Intimidation DC 20 (trained) to scare it away, or Sailing-lore DC 18 (trained) to confuse it; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina:
2 The demon ship uses its actions on one of the following options (GM's choice). It loses one action from its routine if a PC succeeds at an attempt to Disable it or it reaches its Broken Threshold.
• Broadside Blast a The demon ship makes a Chthonian cannon Strike.
• Demonic List d Effect The ship tosses and turns. Each creature in the hazard's area must make a Reflex DC 20 save. On a failure, it is knocked Prone; on a critical failure it also takes 2d10 bludgeoning damage.
• Heads Will Roll a It makes a bowsprit Strike.
• Sea Chantey a (auditory) All fiends within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects; all non-fiends within 60 feet must succeed at a Will DC 20 save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

—
Effect: Sea Chantey

doom-of-tomorrow.descripcion: The sounds of devastation rise from the diorama, and a beam of shimmering energy lances outward from the tiny model of Gauntlight.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to quickly deactivate the model of Gauntlight before it triggers, or Stealth DC 23 (trained) to creep by a trap without triggering it.
datos.reinicio: Each trap resets automatically after 1 hour.

dragged-to-the-depths.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door
dragged-to-the-depths.descripcion: A giant squid rams the ship from below, using its beak to puncture the hull. It then wraps its tentacles around the mast, rocking the ship violently.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 20 to pull the tentacles from the mast, stopping the ship from rocking; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (two actions) On its initiative, the squid uses its first action to pull on the mast Every creature must attempt a Reflex DC 20 save On a failure, it falls Prone If a creature is prone when attempting the save, it slides 10 feet in a direction determined by the GM on a failure If this movement would force a creature off the ship, it can attempt to Grab an Edge The squid uses its second action to make one tentacle attack
datos.reinicio: The squid releases the ship for one round before regripping the mast and resetting the hazard The hazard no longer resets once the PCs defeat the naiads or they flee

dragon-s-death-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-01: Citadel of Corruption
dragon-s-death-1-2.descripcion: The pile of bones transforms into a Large silver dragon, while the PCs appear to transform into dark, shadowy figures of alien physique. The dragon's flesh appears to slowly dissolve into lines of black smoke, which trail away toward the PCs and appear to be absorbed into their bodies. Once the dragon is stripped of flesh, its skeleton explodes in a shower of bone fragments.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) to exorcise the spirit (two actions), or Diplomacy DC 23 (trained) to calm the spirit momentarily (two actions).
datos.rutina:
Trigger A creature comes within 15 feet of the dragon skull

—

Effect All living creatures within 20 feet of the nest are peppered with bone shards and take 2d10+7 slashing damage (basic Reflex DC 20 save).
datos.reinicio: 1 minute, as the bone fragments slowly move back into a neat pile with the skull on top.

dream-pollen-pod.fuente: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On
dream-pollen-pod.descripcion: Four magical plants inside the wagon release hallucinogenic pollen when disturbed.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to carefully remove a pollen pod or Nature DC 18 (trained) to prevent a pod from bursting.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each removed or disabled pollen pod. The trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour, when the pods have regrown additional pollen. If all the pods are removed or disabled, the trap doesn't reset.

duty-s-soulshackle-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
duty-s-soulshackle-3-4.descripcion: A length of humanoid spine is held into a staff by the hooked chain embedded in and entwined around it. Additional spectral chains of pure shadowstuff hold it aloft and sinuously surround it.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 23, Occultism DC 23, or Religion DC 23 (trained) to disrupt the spectral energies channeled by the intelligent item. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one. When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled.
datos.rutina: (three actions) On its initiative, Duty's Soulshackle first uses Call to Serve if it's able to and spends any remaining actions making velstrac chains Strikes against its enemies.

earth-falls-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need
earth-falls-3-4.descripcion: The area has become unstable as part of the swamp is pulled into another plane, causing sinkholes to spontaneously form.

datos.desactivar: Arcana,nature,thievery DC 18 (trained) three times to counter the planar energies.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) On its turn each round, two new 10-foot-square sinkholes, 10 feet deep, randomly appear on the map. Until a creature of size Small or larger steps in the area of one, it looks no different than the surrounding area. If a creature takes an action to seek and succeeds at a Perception DC 18 check, it notices the hazardous square.

electric-lock-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-12: Snakes in the Grass
electric-lock-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune imprinted on a chest's lock releases a powerful electrical discharge.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (expert) to scratch out the rune without allowing electricity to flow, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the rune

eloise-s-last-gasp-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-02: The East Hill Haunting
eloise-s-last-gasp-1-2.descripcion: An obscuring fog covers the entirety of the hallway and northern room of the manor's second floor. Anyone moving through the area is subjected to an attack from a ghostly assailant.

datos.desactivar:
Acrobatics DC 20 to maneuver through the fog, Religion DC 18 to ward off the spirit, or Stealth DC 20 to move through the fog without attracting attention.

Disabling the haunt requires two successful checks, and each attempt takes two actions.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The haunt uses an action to manifest an illusory shadow beside a creature ending its move in the fog, then attempts a spectral touch Strike against that creature. The shadow disappears after the Strike.
datos.reinicio: The haunt lasts until disabled. It re-forms after 1 hour unless Eloise's ghost is put to permanent rest.

empowered-bloodmoon-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades
empowered-bloodmoon-3-4.descripcion: Bloodmoon is a naginata that can act on its own provided it is attuned to at least one creature.

datos.desactivar: Two successful Religion DC 20 or Occultism DC 20 checks, Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18)
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Bloodmoon uses its first action to fly up to 20 feet towards an opponent. It then makes two naginata strikes, each against a different foe.

empowered-deskari-effigy.descripcion: A statuette of the deceased demon lord creates frightening illusions of insect swarms.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 20 (expert) or Religion DC 20 (trained) to deactivate the effigy or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 23) to dispel the statuette
datos.reinicio: 1 minute as the illusory insects harass intruders before scuttling into the earth.

encouraging-supervision.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
encouraging-supervision.descripcion: The face of the Azlanti supervisor on the wall animates and begins scolding those in the room for their poor attitudes at work.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 20 to fake a cheerful, positive attitude, or Crafting DC 21 (trained) to show skill at a task; three successful checks are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) The supervisor's voice fills the room and compels everyone within to start smiling. Each creature in the room takes 1d8+4 mental damage and must attempt a Will DC 20 save.

—

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is Drained 1.
datos.reinicio: The ghostly voice ceases its routine 2 rounds after all living creatures leave the room and resets after 6 hours.

eternal-hall-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
eternal-hall-3-4.descripcion: Time distorts along this hallway, making the air feel like sludge.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disrupt the temporal distortions, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to disperse the temporal energy

exploding-stove.descripcion: The stove has been rigged to explode when pressure sensors under the floor are depressed.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disable the pressure sensors, or Survival DC 20 (trained) to safely extinguish the stove fires

explosive-monolith-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-14: Lost in Flames
explosive-monolith-5-6.descripcion: A burst of abyssal energy ignites the sap in a nearby bruorsivi, which explodes in a burst of fiery splinters.

datos.desactivar:
Arcana DC 20, Occultism DC 20, or Religion DC 20 to magically alter the runes, or Thievery DC 23 to physically alter them. A PC that can read Abyssal or Cyclops is better able to identify key runes, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to these check (+2 if they speak both).

Each check requires two actions, and disabling the monolith requires three successful checks. A PC that critically succeeds earns two success. On a failed check, the attempting PC is exposed to the burning flames wreathing the monolith, taking 2d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 20).
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On the hazard's turn, randomly select a PC within 40 feet of the monolith. A tree near that PC explodes in a 10-foot burst, dealing 2d6 piercing damage and 2d6 fire damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex DC 20 save.

—

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is Blinded for 1 round.

falling-bridge.descripcion: The frayed ropes on both sides of this bridge snap when enough weight is put on the bridge's center.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) to reinforce and secure the ropes on one side of the bridge

falling-crates.descripcion: A tower of precariously stacked crates is rigged to fall when someone steps through a trip wire.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to carefully remove the trip wire.

falling-stalactites.descripcion: Unstable stalactites fall from the ceiling.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) to remove a stalactite without triggering a fall

false-floor.descripcion: The floor in this chamber is an illusion, which conceals a 40-foot drop to the true floor below. Additionally, the area beneath the floor is magically silenced-no sound is audible within nor does sound leave this space.

datos.desactivar: Succeeding on a Perception DC 21 check against the Stealth DC of 21 (including the check to find the trap) disbelieves the illusory floor, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to dispel the illusory floor; dispel magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 20) to dispel the magical silence
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 round.

fascinating-lecture-1-2.descripcion: The semitransparent image of a small Garundi woman at the podium suddenly begins lecturing on the nature of enchantment magic.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 17 to disrupt the lecture, Thievery DC 20 (trained) to scratch out of one of the glyphs on the podium, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract one of the runes; three total successes are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) (arcane, compulsion, enchantment, mental, nonlethal) The image lectures on incredibly advanced topics without pause, overwhelming the minds of those listening while compelling them to continue to pay attention. Each creature in the room must succeed at a Will DC 20 save and take 1d6 nonlethal mental damage, as well as the following effects.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Stunned 1 and takes half damage as it shakes off most of the mental load.

Failure The creature is Stunned 2 and takes full damage as it can't help but try and process all the information.

Critical Failure The creature is stunned for 1 round, Fascinated for 1 minute, and takes double damage as all its mental faculties are focused on the lecture. Damage from this hazard does not end the fascinated condition. A creature who is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the fascinating lecture enters a catatonic stupor until they regain Hit Points. If a creature spends 1 hour in the stupor, they automatically regain 1 Hit Point and awaken.
